# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-aimingBlock

# Aiming block

A block that keeps a [target](glossary.md#target) place: a launcher's, a gate's other end. Where it comes from is your choice, and rules change it any time.

## How to add it

- New thing > Machines and networks > Aiming block


## What you can set

### Aims at a place

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name of the target | The name the target is kept under, among the block's own numbers (name X, Y and Z). Rules that keep or read a place by this name reach it too. |
| Where it aims | Where the target comes from. Kept: the numbers below, or what a rule, a command or a designator wrote. The others are looked for each time it is asked. Choose one of: The numbers kept in it, A place the world remembers by name, The block it is linked to, The nearest block on a channel, A mob or player on a pointer's channel. |
| East or west (X) | Where it aims at first, along east and west. A rule or a designator item changes it later. From -30000000 to 30000000. |
| Height (Y) | Where it aims at first, how high. From -2048 to 2048. |
| North or south (Z) | Where it aims at first, along north and south. From -30000000 to 30000000. |
| Name of the place | A place the world remembers under this name (a rule or a designator item keeps it); the block follows it when it moves. |
| Channel | The channel's name: blocks linked on it, or mobs and players a rule put on it. |
| Looks as far as | How far from the block it looks for the nearest one, in blocks. From 1 to 30000000 blocks. |

Every block also has the settings on the [Block](editor-block.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Aims at a place.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md), [Sound](editor-sound.md), [Particle](editor-particle.md), [Item](editor-item.md), [Code](editor-code.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-altar

# Altar

A block that performs rituals with offerings on pedestals around it, formed while a ring of gold blocks lies around it; say in its rules what forming does: summon, teleport, give, open a portal.

## How to add it

- New thing > Machines and networks > Altar


## What you can set

### Formed from a pattern

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Pattern | A ring: the eight blocks around it on its own level. Below: the nine under it. A cube: all twenty-six around it. Your own: the places you list, turned the way it faces. Any size: a box or a group of touching blocks it finds by looking, its size between a smallest and a largest. Choose one of: a ring around it, a floor under it, a cube around it, places of your own, drawn, any size, found by looking. |
| Build shape | A box: walls on all six sides round an inside. An open box: walls and a floor, no roof. Touching: every block of the build that touches another, any shape; it grows as blocks are added. Choose one of: a box, an open box, blocks that touch. |
| Smallest across | The fewest blocks across (both ways), the walls counted. From 3 to 64. |
| Largest across | The most blocks across (both ways), the walls counted. From 3 to 64. |
| Lowest | The fewest blocks high, the floor (and roof) counted. From 2 to 64 blocks. |
| Tallest | The most blocks high, the floor (and roof) counted. From 2 to 64 blocks. |
| Most blocks | The most blocks that may touch in one build; more and it does not form. From 1 to 4096. |
| Blocks of the build | Each kind of block the build is made of: where it may stand, at least and at most how many, and what one is worth. The inside may always be empty. Each row has: Block, Where, At least, At most, Worth. |
| Inside scales | What the room inside the formed build multiplies: its capacities, its rates, both, or nothing. A tank 3 inside holds three times its capacity. Choose one of: nothing, its capacities, its rates, capacities and rates. |
| Made of | The block every place of the pattern must hold. |
| Drawn pattern | The pattern drawn on the Pattern tab, layer by layer: each cell a test a block must pass (a block, a tag, any of several, a fluid, air, anything), and one cell the machine itself. |
| Stands | As it faces: the pattern turns with the machine's front. Any way round: it forms whichever of the four ways it was built. Choose one of: as it faces, any way. |
| Mirrored too | Its mirror copy forms as well, left and right swapped. |
| Several sizes | A band of the drawing that may repeat, so a taller or a longer build forms as well. It forms the largest size that stands. Choose one of: one size, taller, longer. |
| Band from | The first layer (or row, from the front) of the band that repeats, counted from 1. From 1 to 48. |
| Band to | The last layer (or row) of the band that repeats. From 1 to 48. |
| At least | The fewest times the band stands. From 1 to 48. |
| At most | The most times the band stands; at most 16 sizes in all. From 1 to 48. |
| How many of a block | Of the blocks standing in the pattern, at least and at most so many of one: at least 1 item port, at most 2 energy ports. Each row has: Block, At least, At most. |
| Worth of a block | Several kinds of block may stand in one place, each worth so much: a basic cell 1, an elite cell 8. Formed, the machine adds up the worth of the blocks standing in its pattern. Each row has: Block, Worth. |
| Worth scales | What the formed machine's worth multiplies: its capacities, its rates, both, or nothing (its rules still read it). Choose one of: nothing, its capacities, its rates, capacities and rates. |
| Looks | By itself: every second. With an item: when a player uses the item on it, as a hammer or a wrench. By a rule: when a rule says so. Once formed it looks every second, so a block taken away breaks it. Choose one of: by itself, with an item, by a rule. |
| Item | The item (or tag) a player uses on it to make it look and form. |
| Screen only when formed | Before it is formed, using it only says what is missing; its screen opens once it is formed. |
| Ghost of what is missing | While a player is near and it is not formed, a small glowing copy of each missing block stands where it goes. |
| Places | Each place from the block, as a player standing at its front sees it, and the block it must hold. Each row has: Right, Up, Behind, Block. |
| Works only when formed | A machine that makes nothing until its pattern is complete, as a machine built of many blocks does. |

### Performs rituals

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Pedestals within | How far from it, on its own level and one up or down, a pedestal's item counts as an offering. From 1 to 8 blocks. |
| Started with | The item a player uses on it to start a ritual, which is not used up. Empty: using it with an empty hand while sneaking. |

Every block also has the settings on the [Block](editor-block.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Formed from a pattern, Performs rituals.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md), [Sound](editor-sound.md), [Particle](editor-particle.md), [Item](editor-item.md), [Code](editor-code.md).

Other things that open the same editor: [Block](thing-block.md), [Machine](thing-machine.md), [Generator](thing-generator.md), [Cable](thing-cable.md), [Pipe](thing-pipe.md), [Item pipe](thing-itemPipe.md), [Tank](thing-tank.md), [Transmitter](thing-wirelessTransmitter.md), [Receiver](thing-wirelessReceiver.md), [Wireless energy node](thing-wirelessNode.md), [Shared chest](thing-sharedChest.md), [Shared tank](thing-sharedTank.md), [Chest](thing-chest.md), [Drawer](thing-drawer.md), [Storage crate](thing-crate.md), [Mailbox](thing-mailbox.md), [Trade station](thing-tradeStation.md), [Asking chest](thing-askingChest.md), [Terminal](thing-terminal.md), [Storage cell](thing-storageCell.md), [Storage cable](thing-storageCable.md), [Drive](thing-drive.md), [Network heart](thing-networkHeart.md), [Dense cable](thing-denseCable.md), [Link](thing-storeLink.md), [Access point](thing-accessPoint.md), [Crafter](thing-crafter.md), [Pattern table](thing-patternTable.md), [Matter tank](thing-matterTank.md), [Pedestal](thing-pedestal.md), [Formed machine](thing-formedMachine.md), [Machine casing](thing-machineCasing.md), [Waypoint](thing-waypointBlock.md), [Aiming block](thing-aimingBlock.md), [Berry bush](thing-berryBush.md), [Matter pipe](thing-matterPipe.md), [Assembly station](thing-assemblyStation.md), [Carved block](thing-carvedBlock.md), [Ore](thing-ore.md), [Crop](thing-crop.md), [Plant](thing-plant.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-animation

# Animation

How a model moves over time.

## How to add it

- New thing > Mobs and models > Animation


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Animation](editor-animation.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | A name for you, shown in the project and on a mob's Animations tab. Players never see it. |
| Model | The model whose parts this animation moves. It has to be one made for a mob, because the animation is kept by that model's parts. |
| Keys | How each part turns, moves and grows over time. Edited on the Animate tab. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is written into the mod when you [Cook](glossary.md#cook) or press [Play](glossary.md#play).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-dependency

# Another mod

A mod this one uses or works with, such as a recipe viewer: built against, in the test game, and named in both manifests.

## How to add it

- New thing > Logic and code > Another mod


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Another mod](editor-dependency.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | The mod's name, as players know it. |
| Store name | The name this mod has on the store, kept when you add it from there so it can be fetched again for other versions. |
| Mod id on NeoForge | Its id on NeoForge, written into this mod's manifest. Leave it empty when it is not on NeoForge. |
| Mod id on Fabric | Its id on Fabric, written into this mod's manifest. Leave it empty when it is not on Fabric. |
| Its NeoForge jar | The other mod's jar for NeoForge, picked from disk. Its things join every picker; your code compiles against it. |
| Its Fabric jar | The other mod's jar for Fabric, picked from disk. Its things join every picker; your code compiles against it. |
| Its jars | The other mod's jars, one for NeoForge and one for Fabric on each game version this mod is made for, picked from disk or fetched from the mod store. Its things join every picker; your code compiles against them; the test game runs with them. Each row has: Jar, Made for, Game version, Is. |
| This mod adds to it | This mod is an add-on of it. Its area values, kinds of energy, genes, species and studies show in your lists by their names, and your species join its genes. |
| Needed | Required: a player must install it. Optional: this mod works with it when it is there. Choose one of: Required, Optional. |
| From version | The lowest version of it this mod works with. |
| Compiled against | Coordinates both targets compile against, such as its common API; several separated by spaces. Each is group:name:version, as the mod's page for developers lists it, such as com.example:examplemod-common-api:1.0.0. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is not part of the game itself: it describes another mod or a file, so it has no side to choose.

## What it works with

It does not point at other things.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-areaValue

# Area value

A number the world keeps by place, not by player or item: an aura in each chunk, an oil reservoir under it, radiation, a corruption that spreads, a pollution. Where it is kept, how it starts, spreads and comes back, and what happens as it rises or falls are its own; rules read, add, take and set it at any place.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Area value


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Area value](editor-areaValue.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | What the value is called in the game, such as Aura or Oil. |
| Game name | The value's game name in the game; the world saves it by this, and rules of another mod read it by it. |
| Kept for each | The area that holds one number: each chunk (16 by 16 blocks, all the way down), each square of chunks, each biome, or each dimension. Choose one of: Chunk, Square of chunks, Biome, Dimension, Block, Sealed room. |
| Square size | How many chunks across one square is. From 2 to 64 chunks. |
| Starts as | What a place has the first time it is asked of: the number below, a random number between the two (the same in the same world), or a smooth noise between them so nearby places are alike. Choose one of: The number, Random in a range, Smooth noise. |
| Starts at | What a place starts with, or the low end of its range. A formula of the place may stand in, such as its height. From -1000000000 to 1000000000. |
| Up to | The high end of the range a place starts in. From -1000000000 to 1000000000. |
| Chance of any | How many places in a hundred start with any at all; the rest start at the least, as most chunks hold no oil. From 0 to 100 percent. |
| Least | It never goes below this. From -1000000000 to 1000000000. |
| Most | It never goes above this; a HUD bar is full at it. From -1000000000 to 1000000000. |
| Comes back | How much it moves back by itself each second, as an aura recovers or radiation fades. Nought leaves it to the rules. A place far from everyone is caught up when next asked. From 0 to 1000000000 perSecond. |
| Comes back to | Where it settles: where the place started, its least, or its most. Choose one of: Where it started, Its least, Its most. |
| Spreads | How much of the difference with each area beside it moves across each second, in a hundred. Nought keeps each area to itself. From 0 to 100 percent. |
| Spreads how | Evens out, more flowing to less as an aura does; or grows outward from the areas at or above a level without them losing any, as a corruption does. Choose one of: Evens out, Grows outward. |
| Grows from | Only areas at or above this number grow into the areas beside them. From -1000000000 to 1000000000. |
| Blocks that push it | A block that raises or lowers the number round it, within a radius: a heater, a climatiser, a vent. Every such block near a place counts. The number is read at the place, not kept. Each row has: Block, Pushes by, Within, Reaches. |
| Blocks it turns | Where the number is high enough, blocks of a kind turn into another kind: grass into a dead grass, stone into a rot. A turn can need a block of another kind beside it, which makes it spread block to block. Each row has: Block that turns, Becomes, Only beside, Chance each try, Where it is at least, Each turn adds. |
| Vent blocks | A closed space with one of these blocks touching it keeps a number of its own, found by a fill from the place: air, pressure, heat. Open to the outside, too big, or with no vent, a place reads the outside number (the dimension's). Each row has: Block, Gives a second. |
| A new room starts at | What a room holds the first time it is sealed. Outside, the number starts as the settings above say, so an airless world can start at nought. From -1000000000 to 1000000000. |
| A step every | How often the blocks that hold it make, burn, cool, lose and pass it on: 20 ticks is a second. From 1 to 1200 ticks. |
| Blocks that hold it | Each kind of block that holds the number, such as a reactor's fuel cells, its casing and a heat sink, and how each passes it on, makes it, loses it and what happens at its limit. Each row has: Block, Passes on, Makes, Loses, Limit, At the limit, Turns into, Blast power, Lights at, Fuel let in, Lights when it holds, Uses up, Fuel let in by. |
| Redstone stops it | While a block of a build gets a redstone signal, the blocks joined to it make and burn nothing, as a reactor's shutdown lever does. Coolant and losing go on. |

## What it becomes in the game

It runs on the player's side of the game.

## What it works with

It does not point at other things.

## Picture

![Area value](/media/docs/editor-areaValue.webp)

- [Glossary](glossary.md)

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-armour

# Armor

Something worn that protects.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Armor


## What you can set

### Worn

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Worn on | Which slot it goes in: one of the four armor slots, or a slot of the shared slot mod a player installs beside it, on NeoForge and on Fabric 1.21.1. Without that mod a ring or a belt works from the off hand. Choose one of: Head, Chest, Legs, Feet, Ring, Necklace, Belt, Back, Hands, Another slot. |
| Slot name | The name the slot mod gives that slot, such as charm or head/face. |
| Material | Pieces with the same material share its numbers and its worn picture, like iron or diamond. Leave it empty and the piece is its own material. |
| Armor points | The armor points it gives, each half a shirt over the health bar: an iron chestplate gives 6, iron boots 2. From 0 to 30. |
| Body color | The color it is drawn in on its wearer. |
| On the body | The picture it is drawn in on its wearer, on the game's layout of worn armor, painted as any picture is; without one it is drawn in its color. |
| Toughness | How much of a heavy hit the armor still stops: diamond 2, netherite 3. From 0 to 20. |
| Stands firm | How much less its wearer is pushed back by a hit, from nought to one: netherite 0.1 a piece. From 0 to 1. |
| Worn shape | A model of yours drawn on whoever wears it, a player or a mob: a hat, wings, a jetpack, a full suit. Each group named for a body part (Head, Body, Right arm, Left arm, Right leg, Left leg) moves with that part; Make one starts it on the wearer's body. |
| Follows | The body part a group of the shape follows when its name is not a body part's. Choose one of: The part its slot is on, Head, Body, Right arm, Left arm, Right leg, Left leg. |
| Its animations | Animations of the worn shape, each playing while its wearer does something or while a value of the piece is on: wings that flap while flying, a flame while the engine is on. Several play at once. Each row has: Animation, While, Value. |
| Parts shown only | A group of the worn shape drawn only while something holds: a module's part while its value is on, a visor while crouching. Groups not named here are always drawn. Each row has: Group, While, Value. |
| Or a carved shape | A block you carved on its Carve tab, worn on the body part in place of the flat armor, in the real pictures of its looks. A worn shape above wins. |
| Width on the body | How many pixels across the carved block or copied design is drawn on the wearer. A head is 8; 10 sits over it like a helmet. From 1 to 48. |
| Takes a carved design | Sneak and use this on a carved block to copy its design onto the item, then wear it to show the design on the body part. Sneak and use in the air to clear it. The block stays. Set the size above. |
| Tint | A color the worn shape's picture is multiplied by; white keeps it as painted. |
| Glows | The worn shape is drawn at full light, bright in the dark. |
| See-through | How much you see through the worn shape, from 0 (solid) to 90. From 0 to 90. |
| Hides the flat armor | The game's flat armor picture is not drawn, only the worn shape. |
| Only for its look over | While it is worn, the armor in this slot keeps protecting but is not drawn, and this piece is drawn in its place: a cosmetic slot. Choose one of: Nothing, The helmet, The chestplate, The leggings, The boots. |

### Wears out

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Uses before it breaks | How many blocks it mines, hits it lands or hits it takes before it breaks: iron 250, diamond 1561. From 1 to 100000. |
| Mended with | What mends it in an anvil, such as an iron ingot, or one of this mod's own things. |
| Comes enchanted with | Enchantments it has from the first time a player holds it, the game's own or your own, each at its level. Each row has: Enchantment, Level. |
| Enchants how well | How good the enchantments it is offered are: iron 14, diamond 10, gold 22. From 0 to 50. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Worn, Wears out.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md).

Other things that open the same editor: [Item](thing-item.md), [Crate](thing-lootCrate.md), [Backpack](thing-backpack.md), [Settings copier](thing-settingsCopier.md), [Letter](thing-letter.md), [Pocket](thing-pocket.md), [Storage disk](thing-storageDisk.md), [Disk for fluids](thing-fluidDisk.md), [Wireless terminal](thing-wirelessTerminal.md), [Upgrade](thing-upgrade.md), [Structure finder](thing-structureFinder.md), [Pointer](thing-pointer.md), [Designator](thing-designator.md), [Item filter](thing-itemFilter.md), [Configurator](thing-configurator.md), [Face part](thing-facePart.md), [Waypoint compass](thing-waypointCompass.md), [Spell wand](thing-spellWand.md), [Spell book](thing-spellBook.md), [Spell scroll](thing-spellScroll.md), [Tool](thing-tool.md), [Weapon](thing-weapon.md), [Food](thing-food.md), [Fuel](thing-fuel.md), [Bow](thing-bow.md), [Crossbow](thing-crossbow.md), [Shield](thing-shield.md), [Part](thing-part.md), [Tool of parts](thing-partsTool.md), [Golem-style creature](thing-partsCreature.md), [Battery](thing-battery.md), [Powered tool](thing-poweredTool.md), [Powered armour](thing-poweredArmour.md), [Building wand](thing-buildingWand.md), [Copy wand](thing-copyWand.md), [Capsule](thing-capsule.md), [Building plan](thing-buildingPlan.md), [Mob catcher](thing-mobCatcher.md), [Carving tool](thing-carvingTool.md), [Bag of pieces](thing-bitBag.md), [Shape pattern](thing-shapePattern.md), [Tree axe](thing-treeAxe.md), [Vein pickaxe](thing-veinPickaxe.md), [Module](thing-module.md), [Building tool](thing-builder.md), [Thrown weapon](thing-thrown.md), [Music disc](thing-musicDisc.md), [Shears](thing-shears.md), [Fishing rod](thing-fishingRod.md), [Tool for everything](thing-multiTool.md), [Hat](thing-hat.md), [Vehicle part](thing-vehiclePart.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-askingChest

# Asking chest

A chest that keeps itself stocked from the storage network or by couriers.

## How to add it

- New thing > Machines and networks > Asking chest


## What you can set

### Inventory

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Slots | How many stacks it holds, up to 256. Past six rows, its screen scrolls them or shows them all, as Screen shows says. From 1 to 256. |
| Screen shows | How its screen lays out more rows than six, until you lay it out on the Screen tab: six rows and a bar that scrolls the rest, or every slot at once in a screen grown to fit them. Choose one of: Six rows and a scroll bar, The whole grid at once. |
| Slots across | How many slots a row of its screen holds, 1 to 24. Past nine, the screen grows wider. From 1 to 24. |
| Items per slot | The most of one thing a slot takes. The game reads it live, so a mod setting can stand in. From 1 to 64. |
| Most a second | The most that moves in or out of it each second along a network. Hoppers keep their own speed. From 1 to 1024. |
| No limit | On: items cross this block as fast as the blocks at both ends can give and take. The number above is ignored. |
| Items travel at | How fast an item crosses this block on a pipe that passes items on. At nought an item arrives the moment the network moves it. Above nought it takes time to cross, pipe by pipe, and each pipe holds and keeps what is inside it. From 0 to 20 blocksPerSecond. |
| Shares the cards in it | Every value card put in it gives its value by its name, to the whole world or to the cable network it sits on, so a reader or a sum anywhere there can use the name. A card named in an anvil uses that name; otherwise the item's own. Choose one of: No, With the whole world, On its cable network. |
| Opens a screen | Used by hand, it opens its slots in a screen laid out on the Screen tab. |
| Takes back with | Empty hand: any empty hand takes the item back. Sneaking: only an empty hand while sneaking does. Choose one of: An empty hand, Sneaking, empty hand. |
| Put in and take out by hand | A block with no screen takes the stack in the player's hand when used, and gives it back to an empty hand (sneaking or not), as a lectern or a decorated pot does. Turn it off when only machines and commands fill it. |
| Screen | The machine's screen, laid out on the Screen tab. Until it is changed there, the product draws it from the slots and gauges. |

### Asks for items

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Asks for | Each row is a thing it wants and how many it keeps. Each row has: Thing, Keeps at least. |
| Asks | Who brings what it lacks: the storage network beside it, couriers (workers whose job is Deliver), or both. Choose one of: The storage network, Couriers, Both. |
| When no store has it | What happens when nobody holds the thing it asks for. Wait keeps the request open. Ask for crafting makes one crafting job for the missing amount, once, if the storage network can make it, and a courier brings it when it is made. Choose one of: Wait, Ask for crafting. |
| Asks again every | Seconds to wait before it asks for crafting again when the first try failed (no pattern, or not enough materials). Nobody is told. From 1 to 3600 seconds. |

Every block also has the settings on the [Block](editor-block.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-assemblyStation

# Assembly station

A block with a screen where a player fits, tunes, mends, names and takes apart the tool in their hand.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Assembly station


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Block](editor-block.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | What players read in the game, in any words: spaces and capitals are fine, like "Ruby Blade of Sam". The Game name is the short name the game uses instead. You can change it any time. |
| Game name | The short name the game and its commands use: small letters, digits and underscores, like katana. In commands and recipes the mod's short name and a colon go in front: for a mod called rubygear, katana is written rubygear, a colon, then katana. Players never read it; that is the Name. Change it later and it is renamed everywhere. |
| Texture | The picture on every face of the block. |
| Time to break | How hard the block is; stone is 1.5, dirt 0.5. Higher is slower; obsidian is 50. The overview shows the seconds by hand. From 0 to 3600. |
| Form | The game's own shapes, each drawn from this block's picture and working as the game's own does: stairs you walk up, a slab that doubles, a fence and a wall that join their neighbours, a door and a trapdoor that open, a button and a pressure plate that give a redstone signal, a pane, a carpet, leaves that fall away when no log is near, a pillar that lies the way it is placed, and a rail the game's carts ride. Choose one of: A full block, Stairs, A slab, A wall, A fence, A fence gate, A door, A trapdoor, A pressure plate, A button, A pane, as glass and bars, A carpet, Leaves, A pillar, as a log, A rail, A slope, A slope, outer corner, A slope, inner corner, A ridge, as a roof top, A quarter round, as an arch, A round pillar, A window frame. |
| Wears the block used on it | Off, the shape shows this block's own picture. On, a player can use any full block on it, from this mod, the game or another mod, and the shape then shows that block's pictures instead, grass and leaves colours included. Using nothing while sneaking gives the block back, and breaking the shape gives it back too. The slope, corners, ridge, quarter round, round pillar and window frame turn to face you and hang upside down when placed on a ceiling or on the top half of a side, like stairs. |
| Turns carts | Whether a cart rolling onto it goes off to one side instead of straight on: never, while redstone powers it, or by the cart, when the cart matches the list below. Lay track on three sides of it, like a T. Choose one of: Never, While powered, By the cart. |
| Turns to | The side a turned cart goes off to, as the cart sees it coming in: its left or its right. Choose one of: Left, Right. |
| Which carts turn | The carts that turn, any one of these: a kind of cart (a chest minecart), an item it carries (coal), a tag of items (all ores), or the fluid in its tank (water), each by its game name. Empty: every cart turns. |
| Gives a signal | A redstone signal while a cart is on it: for any cart, only a full cart, only an empty cart, or stronger the fuller the cart is. Full counts its chest, its tank and its battery together. Choose one of: Never, For any cart, For a full cart, For an empty cart, By how full. |
| Picture of its ends | The picture on its two ends, as a log shows its rings; its sides wear the block's own picture. With none, the ends wear that too. |
| Picture of the top half | The door's upper half; its lower half and the item in the hand wear the block's own picture. With none, both halves wear that. |
| Works like | Wood: a door or trapdoor opens by hand, a button stays pressed longer and an arrow presses it, a pressure plate feels anything on it, a fence joins the game's wooden fences. Metal or stone: only redstone opens a door or trapdoor, and only a player or a mob presses a plate. Choose one of: Wood, Metal or stone. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md), [Sound](editor-sound.md), [Particle](editor-particle.md), [Item](editor-item.md), [Code](editor-code.md).

Other things that open the same editor: [Block](thing-block.md), [Machine](thing-machine.md), [Generator](thing-generator.md), [Cable](thing-cable.md), [Pipe](thing-pipe.md), [Item pipe](thing-itemPipe.md), [Tank](thing-tank.md), [Transmitter](thing-wirelessTransmitter.md), [Receiver](thing-wirelessReceiver.md), [Wireless energy node](thing-wirelessNode.md), [Shared chest](thing-sharedChest.md), [Shared tank](thing-sharedTank.md), [Chest](thing-chest.md), [Drawer](thing-drawer.md), [Storage crate](thing-crate.md), [Mailbox](thing-mailbox.md), [Trade station](thing-tradeStation.md), [Asking chest](thing-askingChest.md), [Terminal](thing-terminal.md), [Storage cell](thing-storageCell.md), [Storage cable](thing-storageCable.md), [Drive](thing-drive.md), [Network heart](thing-networkHeart.md), [Dense cable](thing-denseCable.md), [Link](thing-storeLink.md), [Access point](thing-accessPoint.md), [Crafter](thing-crafter.md), [Pattern table](thing-patternTable.md), [Matter tank](thing-matterTank.md), [Altar](thing-altar.md), [Pedestal](thing-pedestal.md), [Formed machine](thing-formedMachine.md), [Machine casing](thing-machineCasing.md), [Waypoint](thing-waypointBlock.md), [Aiming block](thing-aimingBlock.md), [Berry bush](thing-berryBush.md), [Matter pipe](thing-matterPipe.md), [Carved block](thing-carvedBlock.md), [Ore](thing-ore.md), [Crop](thing-crop.md), [Plant](thing-plant.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-attribute

# Attribute

A number every living thing has, as luck and armor are.

## How to add it

- New thing > Mobs and models > Attribute


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Attribute](editor-attribute.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | The attribute's name, as an item's tooltip shows it. |
| Game name | The attribute's name in the game, as the attribute command and a rule's words name it. |
| Starts at | What every living thing has until an item, an effect or a rule changes it. From -1000000 to 1000000. |
| Lowest | The lowest and the highest it can be, however much is added. From -1000000 to 1000000. |
| Highest | The lowest and the highest it can be, however much is added. From -1000000 to 1000000. |
| Given by | Items that give some of it while held or worn, as a sword gives attack damage. Each row has: Item, Gives, While. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is not part of the game itself: it describes another mod or a file, so it has no side to choose.

## What it works with

It does not point at other things.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-backpack

# Backpack

An item with slots of its own, opened from the hand.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Backpack


## What you can set

### Holds items

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Slots | How many stacks it holds. From 1 to 54. |
| Slots mark items | The slots keep a picture of an item instead of the item. A player clicks an item on a slot to mark it, and clicks with an empty hand to clear it, so nothing is ever taken from them. This is how a filter you can edit in the game works. |
| Picks up | Carried anywhere in the inventory, it takes what the player walks over before the player's own slots do. |
| Picks up only | The items it picks up, each an item or a #tag. Empty, it picks up anything that fits in it. |
| Only what it holds | It only picks up the kinds already in its slots. Put one in to teach it. |
| Most in a slot | How many of one item a slot holds. 64 is the game's own; set it higher for a slot that holds thousands. From 1 to 2147483647. |
| Keeps at least | When something is taken out, this many stay in the slot. 0 lets the slot empty. From 0 to 99999. |
| Uses what it holds | Used, it acts as the thing chosen in it: the last one you clicked in its slots. Crouching, it opens them. |
| Holds other bags | Other things that hold items can go inside it, so you can carry a bag of bags. Off, it refuses them, as a shulker box does. |
| Packs nine into one | While you carry it, nine of a thing in your slots turn into what the crafting grid makes of nine (nine iron ingots become an iron block). |
| Put down as | Used while crouching on the ground, it becomes this block, holding what it held. Break it, or crouch and use it with an empty hand, and it is the same item again, with its name and colour. |
| Most slots with pockets | The most slots it can have once pockets are put in it. Its screen has room for all of them; the ones not opened yet are dark. 0 means it takes no pockets. From 0 to 54. |
| Opens from the inventory | While it is worn, a button on the player's own inventory screen opens it. It drops with its contents when the player dies. |
| Screen | Its screen, laid out on the Screen tab. Until it is changed there, the product draws the slots in rows. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Holds items.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-battery

# Battery

An item that keeps energy: charged in a machine, it charges the tools and armour a player carries, and powers a machine it is put in.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Battery


## What you can set

### Holds energy

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Holds up to | The most energy one of it keeps, in the same units as a machine's energy. From 1 to 1000000000. |
| Kind of energy | What its energy is called: Energy, Mana, or a unit of the mod's own. Items of one kind charge each other; another kind is kept apart unless an item says it mixes. |
| Spends per use | Energy spent for each block it mines, each hit it gives, and each hit its wearer takes while it is worn. 0 spends nothing. From 0 to 1000000000. |
| Spends each second | Energy spent every second while it is held in the hand or worn: a lamp, a jetpack, a suit that keeps its wearer cool. 0 spends nothing. From 0 to 1000000000 perSecond. |
| Charges other items | A battery: once a second it gives its energy to the items that hold energy in the place chosen, at its rate. It never charges another battery. Choose one of: No, Worn, On the head, On the chest, On the legs, On the feet, Charm slots, Ring slot, Necklace slot, Belt slot, Back slot, Gloves slot, Held, In the hand, Off hand, Hotbar, Anywhere carried, Another slot. |
| Slot name | The name the slot mod gives that slot, such as charm or head/face. |
| Draws when it runs short | When it is used and has too little, it takes what it lacks from the items of its kind in the place chosen, such as the tablets in the bag. No: it spends only its own. Choose one of: No, Worn, On the head, On the chest, On the legs, On the feet, Charm slots, Ring slot, Necklace slot, Belt slot, Back slot, Gloves slot, Held, In the hand, Off hand, Hotbar, Anywhere carried. |
| Charges at | How much energy goes in or out of it each second: from a machine, from a battery, or out of it into what it charges or powers. From 1 to 1000000000 perSecond. |
| Worth of 1 FE | How many of this kind one unit of other mods' energy (FE) is worth. At 1 it is the same; at 0.1, ten FE from a charger fill one of it, and a machine drawing 1 of it takes 10 FE. From 0.0001 to 1000000. |
| Mixes kinds | When it charges other items or draws, it also reaches items of another kind, at the worth of each (a converter). |
| Runs machines | Put in a machine's slots, it gives its energy to the machine at its rate, instead of being charged by it. |
| When it is empty | Stops: without the energy of one use, a tool mines as a hand does, a weapon hits as a fist, armour guards nothing and gives nothing, until it is charged. Works on: energy is only spent. Choose one of: It stops working, It works on. |
| Starts charged | How full a new one is, from 0 (empty) to 100 (full). From 0 to 100 percent. |
| Shown | Where a player sees its energy: a bar under the item's picture, a line of its tooltip, both, or nowhere. Choose one of: Bar and tooltip, Bar, Tooltip, Nowhere. |
| Bar colour | The colour of the energy bar under its picture. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Holds energy.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-berryBush

# Berry bush

A block that ripens in a minute in the light and gives berries when a player picks it, then grows again.

## How to add it

- New thing > The world > Berry bush


## What you can set

### Grows over time

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Ripe in | How long it takes to ripen from the start, while it has its light. From 1 to 86400 seconds. |
| Light it needs | The least light where it stands for it to grow, from 0 (dark) to 15 (day). From 0 to 15. |
| Gives | What falls out when a player picks it ripe. |
| How many | How many of it each time. From 1 to 64. |
| Once picked | It grows again from the start, as a berry bush does, or it is gone, as a fruit picked from the ground. Choose one of: it grows again, it is gone. |

Every block also has the settings on the [Block](editor-block.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Grows over time.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-biome

# Biome

A region of the world with its own look and life.

## How to add it

- New thing > The world > Biome


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Biome](editor-biome.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | Its name, which the game shows where it names the biome a player stands in. |
| Game name | The biome's name in the game, as a command finds it: /locate biome. |
| Grass | The colour of its grass. |
| Leaves | The colour of the leaves of its trees and vines. |
| Water | The colour of its water. |
| Sky | The colour of its sky by day. |
| Fog | The colour of the haze in the distance. |
| Music | What plays while a player is there. Left empty, the game's own music plays. |
| Mobs | What lives there. Each is as likely as its weight beside the others of its group. Each row has: Mob, Group, Weight, At least, At most. |
| Ores and caves | The game's own ores, geodes, dungeons, springs and lava lakes, as under its plains. |
| Grass and flowers | The game's own grass, flowers, oaks, mushrooms, pumpkins and sugar cane, as on its plains. |
| Appears | Where the world makes it. A dimension of yours lists its own biomes too. Choose one of: In the overworld, In the nether, Only in a dimension of yours. |
| Placed | Beside one of the game's biomes, in a share of its places; or by its land, in a share of every place of the warmth, wetness and land you choose, so it stands on land of that height and roughness. Choose one of: Beside one of the game's, By its land. |
| In place of | One of the game's biomes: yours appears where it would, in a share of its places. |
| Land | The shape of the land it takes. Its height and roughness come from there: lowlands are flat, mountains steep, valleys low beside rivers, caves under the ground. Choose one of: Any land, Ocean, Coast, Lowlands, Hills, Mountains, Peaks, Valleys, Caves underground. |
| Warmth | How warm the places it takes are, in the game's five bands. Choose one of: Any, Frozen, Cold, Mild, Warm, Hot. |
| Wetness | How wet the places it takes are, from desert dry to jungle wet. Choose one of: Any, Arid, Dry, Middling, Wet, Very wet. |
| Share | How much of that biome's land becomes yours. From 1 to 100 percent. |
| Land height | How far above or below its dimension's land height its ground stands, in a dimension with a shaped land. From -48 to 96 blocks. |
| Roughness | How rough its ground is: nought is flat, a hundred is steep hills and cliffs. Its dimension's hilliness scales it. From 0 to 100 percent. |
| Weather | What falls from its sky. Choose one of: Rain, Snow, Nothing, dry as a desert. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is not part of the game itself: it describes another mod or a file, so it has no side to choose.

## What it works with

It points at: [Particle](editor-particle.md), [Sound](editor-sound.md), [Mob](editor-creature.md), [Caves](editor-carver.md), [Block](editor-block.md).

## Picture

![Biome](/media/docs/editor-biome.webp)

- [Biome](editor-biome.md)
- [Templates and samples](templates-and-samples.md)
- [Glossary](glossary.md)

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-block

# Block

Something placed in the world: ore, stone, a crate.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Block


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Block](editor-block.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | What players read in the game, in any words: spaces and capitals are fine, like "Ruby Blade of Sam". The Game name is the short name the game uses instead. You can change it any time. |
| Game name | The short name the game and its commands use: small letters, digits and underscores, like katana. In commands and recipes the mod's short name and a colon go in front: for a mod called rubygear, katana is written rubygear, a colon, then katana. Players never read it; that is the Name. Change it later and it is renamed everywhere. |
| Texture | The picture on every face of the block. |
| Time to break | How hard the block is; stone is 1.5, dirt 0.5. Higher is slower; obsidian is 50. The overview shows the seconds by hand. From 0 to 3600. |
| Form | The game's own shapes, each drawn from this block's picture and working as the game's own does: stairs you walk up, a slab that doubles, a fence and a wall that join their neighbours, a door and a trapdoor that open, a button and a pressure plate that give a redstone signal, a pane, a carpet, leaves that fall away when no log is near, a pillar that lies the way it is placed, and a rail the game's carts ride. Choose one of: A full block, Stairs, A slab, A wall, A fence, A fence gate, A door, A trapdoor, A pressure plate, A button, A pane, as glass and bars, A carpet, Leaves, A pillar, as a log, A rail, A slope, A slope, outer corner, A slope, inner corner, A ridge, as a roof top, A quarter round, as an arch, A round pillar, A window frame. |
| Wears the block used on it | Off, the shape shows this block's own picture. On, a player can use any full block on it, from this mod, the game or another mod, and the shape then shows that block's pictures instead, grass and leaves colours included. Using nothing while sneaking gives the block back, and breaking the shape gives it back too. The slope, corners, ridge, quarter round, round pillar and window frame turn to face you and hang upside down when placed on a ceiling or on the top half of a side, like stairs. |
| Turns carts | Whether a cart rolling onto it goes off to one side instead of straight on: never, while redstone powers it, or by the cart, when the cart matches the list below. Lay track on three sides of it, like a T. Choose one of: Never, While powered, By the cart. |
| Turns to | The side a turned cart goes off to, as the cart sees it coming in: its left or its right. Choose one of: Left, Right. |
| Which carts turn | The carts that turn, any one of these: a kind of cart (a chest minecart), an item it carries (coal), a tag of items (all ores), or the fluid in its tank (water), each by its game name. Empty: every cart turns. |
| Gives a signal | A redstone signal while a cart is on it: for any cart, only a full cart, only an empty cart, or stronger the fuller the cart is. Full counts its chest, its tank and its battery together. Choose one of: Never, For any cart, For a full cart, For an empty cart, By how full. |
| Picture of its ends | The picture on its two ends, as a log shows its rings; its sides wear the block's own picture. With none, the ends wear that too. |
| Picture of the top half | The door's upper half; its lower half and the item in the hand wear the block's own picture. With none, both halves wear that. |
| Works like | Wood: a door or trapdoor opens by hand, a button stays pressed longer and an arrow presses it, a pressure plate feels anything on it, a fence joins the game's wooden fences. Metal or stone: only redstone opens a door or trapdoor, and only a player or a mob presses a plate. Choose one of: Wood, Metal or stone. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md), [Sound](editor-sound.md), [Particle](editor-particle.md), [Item](editor-item.md), [Code](editor-code.md).

Other things that open the same editor: [Machine](thing-machine.md), [Generator](thing-generator.md), [Cable](thing-cable.md), [Pipe](thing-pipe.md), [Item pipe](thing-itemPipe.md), [Tank](thing-tank.md), [Transmitter](thing-wirelessTransmitter.md), [Receiver](thing-wirelessReceiver.md), [Wireless energy node](thing-wirelessNode.md), [Shared chest](thing-sharedChest.md), [Shared tank](thing-sharedTank.md), [Chest](thing-chest.md), [Drawer](thing-drawer.md), [Storage crate](thing-crate.md), [Mailbox](thing-mailbox.md), [Trade station](thing-tradeStation.md), [Asking chest](thing-askingChest.md), [Terminal](thing-terminal.md), [Storage cell](thing-storageCell.md), [Storage cable](thing-storageCable.md), [Drive](thing-drive.md), [Network heart](thing-networkHeart.md), [Dense cable](thing-denseCable.md), [Link](thing-storeLink.md), [Access point](thing-accessPoint.md), [Crafter](thing-crafter.md), [Pattern table](thing-patternTable.md), [Matter tank](thing-matterTank.md), [Altar](thing-altar.md), [Pedestal](thing-pedestal.md), [Formed machine](thing-formedMachine.md), [Machine casing](thing-machineCasing.md), [Waypoint](thing-waypointBlock.md), [Aiming block](thing-aimingBlock.md), [Berry bush](thing-berryBush.md), [Matter pipe](thing-matterPipe.md), [Assembly station](thing-assemblyStation.md), [Carved block](thing-carvedBlock.md), [Ore](thing-ore.md), [Crop](thing-crop.md), [Plant](thing-plant.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-boat

# Boat

A boat or a raft a player rows on water, with a chest or not.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Boat


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Boat](editor-boat.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | The boat's name, as its item and the game say it. |
| Game name | The boat's name in the game, as a command names it; its chest kind adds chest. |
| Shape | A boat as the game's woods have, or a flat raft as bamboo's. Choose one of: Boat, Raft. |
| Picture | The boat's wood, laid out as the game's own boat pictures are. |
| Item picture | The boat's item, held and in the inventory. |
| With a chest too | Whether it also comes with a chest in it, a boat and item of their own. |
| Chest picture | The boat with its chest, laid out as the game's chest boats are. |
| Chest item picture | The item of the boat with a chest. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is not part of the game itself: it describes another mod or a file, so it has no side to choose.

## What it works with

It does not point at other things.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-boss

# Boss

A hostile mob with a boss bar, special moves and a phase it enters when it is badly hurt.

## How to add it

- New thing > Mobs and models > Boss


## What you can set

### Has a spawn egg

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Egg colour | The colour of the egg itself. |
| Spot colour | The colour of the spots on the egg. |

### Mind

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Moves | Special attacks it winds up and makes at what it fights, each waiting its own time. Each row has: Move, When, Phase, Reach, Wind-up, Cooldown, Hits for, Throws, Summons, How many, Spell, Pays from, Lasts, Blinks, Block it puts, Sound, Picture. |
| Job | What it does when it fights nothing. Choose one of: None, Guards its place, Follows its owner, Gathers items. |
| Reach | How far from where it first stood it guards or gathers. From 2 to 64 blocks. |
| Behaviours | What it does, top to bottom: the top one that can run wins. Drag to change the order. Empty: it keeps its usual ones. Each row has: Behaviour, Speed, Distance, Which creature, Which item or block, Extra, What it shoots, Time between shots, Only when. |

### Boss

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Bar colour | The colour of its bar at full health. Choose one of: Pink, Blue, Red, Green, Yellow, Purple, White. |
| Bar style | A smooth bar, or one cut into notches. Choose one of: Smooth, 6 notches, 10 notches, 12 notches, 20 notches. |
| Darkens sky | The sky darkens for every player who sees its bar, as the Wither's does. |
| Boss music | The game's boss music plays while its bar shows. |
| Fog | Fog closes in while its bar shows, as the Ender Dragon's does. |
| Phases | As its health falls below each share it enters the phase: faster, harder hitting, a state played, a moment it cannot be hurt. Each row has: Name, Below, Speed, Hits, Armour added, Plays, Cannot be hurt for, Bar colour. |

Every mob also has the settings on the [Mob](editor-creature.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Has a spawn egg, Mind, Boss.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md), [Sound](editor-sound.md), [Damage type](editor-damageType.md), [Code](editor-code.md).

Other things that open the same editor: [Mob](thing-creature.md), [Pet](thing-pet.md), [Mount](thing-mount.md), [Flying mount](thing-flyingMount.md), [Sea mount](thing-seaMount.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-bow

# Bow

The game's own bow, drawn and let go, to change: how long it draws, how hard and how fast what it shoots flies.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Bow


## What you can set

### Shoots

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Works like | Which of the game's own it starts from: a bow drawn and let go, a crossbow loaded and then fired, or thrown as a snowball or a trident is, the thing itself flying. Choose one of: The game's Bow, The game's Crossbow, Thrown. |
| Damage | What what it shoots takes from what it hits, where a heart is 2: the game's arrow 2 before its speed counts, a trident 8. From 0 to 1000. |
| Full draw | How long it takes to draw fully; let go sooner and it shoots weaker, as the game's bow does in its 1 second. From 0.05 to 10 seconds. |
| Flies at | How fast what it shoots flies, against the game's own: 1 is the game's, 2 twice as fast and farther. From 0.1 to 5 times. |
| A hit gives | An effect every hit gives what it hits. Choose one of: Nothing extra, Speed, Slowness, Strength, Weakness, Regeneration, Poison, Glowing, Invisibility, Levitation, Fire resistance, Night vision, Jump boost. |
| For | How long the effect of a hit lasts. From 1 to 600 seconds. |
| Burning | What it shoots flies alight and sets what it hits on fire, as the Flame enchantment does. |
| Where it lands | What a thrown thing does when it hits: lies there to be picked up again, or breaks. Choose one of: Lies there, Breaks. |
| Flies | How it is drawn in flight: lying flat and spinning as a throwing star, point first as a javelin, or turned to the camera as the game draws a snowball. Choose one of: Flat, spinning, Point first, Facing the camera. |
| Shoots | What it looses: the game's arrow, or a projectile of your mod's own, which flies by its own settings. Choose one of: Arrow. |
| Shoots | What it takes from the inventory and shoots in place of arrows, yours or the game's, or any item of a tag; picked up again where it lands. With none, arrows. |
| Loading time | How long it takes to load, held before it is ready to fire; the game's crossbow takes 1.25 seconds. From 0.05 to 10 seconds. |
| Shots at once | How many it looses at once from one piece of ammunition, fanned out, as a crossbow with Multishot looses three. From 1 to 16 times. |
| Fan | How wide the shots at once fan out, in degrees from the first to the last. From 0 to 180 degrees. |
| Pause | Seconds before it can be thrown again, as the game's ender pearl waits 1. From 0 to 60 seconds. |
| Drawing | The picture as the draw begins. |
| Half drawn | The picture half way through the draw. |
| Drawn | The picture fully drawn. |
| Loaded | The picture of a crossbow loaded and ready to fire. |

### Wears out

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Uses before it breaks | How many blocks it mines, hits it lands or hits it takes before it breaks: iron 250, diamond 1561. From 1 to 100000. |
| Mended with | What mends it in an anvil, such as an iron ingot, or one of this mod's own things. |
| Comes enchanted with | Enchantments it has from the first time a player holds it, the game's own or your own, each at its level. Each row has: Enchantment, Level. |
| Enchants how well | How good the enchantments it is offered are: iron 14, diamond 10, gold 22. From 0 to 50. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Shoots, Wears out.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-buildingPlan

# Building plan

An item that copies the blocks between two corners and builds the copy again wherever it is used, a few blocks a second, from the player's items.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Building plan


## What you can set

### Captures

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Takes | Blocks (with their contents), or a creature with all it is. Choose one of: Blocks, A creature. |
| When taken | Move lifts the blocks out and places them back once; Copy leaves them and builds a copy from the player's items. Choose one of: Move them, Copy them. |
| Which blocks | A box round the block used on, or between two corners (sneak and use on the first). Choose one of: A box round the block, Between two corners. |
| Width | How many blocks across, centred on the block used on. From 1 to 31 blocks. |
| Height | How many blocks high, from the block used on up. From 1 to 31 blocks. |
| Most blocks | It refuses a box with more blocks than this. From 1 to 32768. |
| Contents go too | A chest keeps its items and a machine its data. Off, they come back empty. |
| Mobs go too | Mobs inside the box are taken with the blocks. |
| Places | Only where all of it fits, where there is room, or over what stands there. Choose one of: Only if all fits, Where there is room, Over what stands. |
| Takes unbreakable | Takes blocks that cannot be broken, like bedrock. |
| Never takes | Blocks and groups it leaves where they are; at first, the blocks no mod may move. |
| Which creatures | Mobs and groups of mobs it may catch, such as cats; empty catches any but bosses. |
| Only your own | Catches only pets the player has tamed. |
| Turns with you | What it places is turned as far as you turned since it took it. |
| Shows a ghost | While held, a see-through ghost shows where it will place; red where there is no room. |
| Builds a second | How many blocks a copy builds each second. From 1 to 400. |
| Each use takes | An item taken from the player each use, such as an ender pearl; empty is free. |
| Cooldown | Seconds before it can be used again. From 0 to 600 seconds. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-builder

# Building tool

Places a square of blocks at once where it is used, a ghost of them shown first.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Building tool


## What you can set

### Places blocks

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Places at once | One block, or a square across the face it is used on. Choose one of: One block, Three by three, Five by five. |
| Takes blocks from | Which block it places: the one in the player's other hand, or a block chosen here. Each one placed is taken from the player, except in creative. Choose one of: The other hand, A block chosen here. |
| Block | The block it places, chosen from the game's blocks and your own. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Places blocks.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-buildingWand

# Building wand

A wand that lays a line, a wall or a box of blocks from a corner a player marks to the block it is used on, outlining it first.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Building wand


## What you can set

### Acts on many blocks

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| What it does | Line: blocks in a straight run from the marked corner to the block used on. Wall: a wall standing on that run, as high as the two corners are apart. Box: the whole box between them. Copy: the box between the marked corner and the block used on is copied, then each use pastes it. Tree: mining a log fells every log of the tree. Vein: mining a block breaks every joined block of its kind. Choose one of: A line, A wall, A box, Copy and paste, Fell a tree, Mine a vein. |
| At most | The most blocks one action places, copies or breaks, 1 to 4096. From 1 to 4096. |
| Places | The block it places: the one in the player's other hand, or one chosen here. Choose one of: Off-hand block, A chosen block. |
| Block | The block it places, picked by its name in the game's list of blocks. |
| Only | The blocks it starts on: one block, or a group of blocks such as every ore. Empty: any block; a tree always starts on a log. |
| Uses up blocks | Each block placed is taken from the player's inventory, as placing it by hand would; off, it places for free. In creative it is always free. |
| Turns with you | A paste is turned as far as the player has turned since the copy: copied facing north, pasted facing east, it is turned a quarter, doors and stairs too. |
| Outline first | While it is held, what it would place, copy or break is outlined round the block under the cross, before anything is done. |
| Can undo | Used in the air while sneaking, it puts back what its last action changed and gives the blocks back, up to ten actions back. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Acts on many blocks.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md).

Other things that open the same editor: [Item](thing-item.md), [Crate](thing-lootCrate.md), [Backpack](thing-backpack.md), [Settings copier](thing-settingsCopier.md), [Letter](thing-letter.md), [Pocket](thing-pocket.md), [Storage disk](thing-storageDisk.md), [Disk for fluids](thing-fluidDisk.md), [Wireless terminal](thing-wirelessTerminal.md), [Upgrade](thing-upgrade.md), [Structure finder](thing-structureFinder.md), [Pointer](thing-pointer.md), [Designator](thing-designator.md), [Item filter](thing-itemFilter.md), [Configurator](thing-configurator.md), [Face part](thing-facePart.md), [Waypoint compass](thing-waypointCompass.md), [Spell wand](thing-spellWand.md), [Spell book](thing-spellBook.md), [Spell scroll](thing-spellScroll.md), [Tool](thing-tool.md), [Weapon](thing-weapon.md), [Armor](thing-armour.md), [Food](thing-food.md), [Fuel](thing-fuel.md), [Bow](thing-bow.md), [Crossbow](thing-crossbow.md), [Shield](thing-shield.md), [Part](thing-part.md), [Tool of parts](thing-partsTool.md), [Golem-style creature](thing-partsCreature.md), [Battery](thing-battery.md), [Powered tool](thing-poweredTool.md), [Powered armour](thing-poweredArmour.md), [Copy wand](thing-copyWand.md), [Capsule](thing-capsule.md), [Building plan](thing-buildingPlan.md), [Mob catcher](thing-mobCatcher.md), [Carving tool](thing-carvingTool.md), [Bag of pieces](thing-bitBag.md), [Shape pattern](thing-shapePattern.md), [Tree axe](thing-treeAxe.md), [Vein pickaxe](thing-veinPickaxe.md), [Module](thing-module.md), [Building tool](thing-builder.md), [Thrown weapon](thing-thrown.md), [Music disc](thing-musicDisc.md), [Shears](thing-shears.md), [Fishing rod](thing-fishingRod.md), [Tool for everything](thing-multiTool.md), [Hat](thing-hat.md), [Vehicle part](thing-vehiclePart.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-cable

# Cable

Carries energy between machines. It holds nothing of its own.

## How to add it

- New thing > Machines and networks > Cable


## What you can set

### Energy

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Most it holds | Its buffer. Set it to nothing for a cable, which holds nothing of its own. From 0 to 1000000000. |
| Most a second | The most that crosses this block each second. A run of cable carries as much as its narrowest one, not the sum of them. From 0 to 1000000000. |
| No limit | On: energy cross this block as fast as the blocks at both ends can give and take. The number above is ignored. |

### Connections

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Faces | Which of the six faces connect, and to what. Open the Connections tab to set them. |
| What arrives | A cable or a pipe passes it on and holds nothing. A machine, a tank or a battery keeps it. Choose one of: It keeps it, It passes it on. |
| Served before others | When several blocks want the same thing and there is not enough, the higher number is filled first. Equal numbers take turns. From -64 to 64. |
| Serves first | Whom what leaves it goes to first, for items, fluids and every stock: shared by priority, each block in turn, or the nearest along the pipes. Choose one of: By priority, Each in turn, The nearest. |
| Faces have colours | A coloured face joins only faces of its colour. Off, faces ignore colour. |
| Dyes a face steps through | How many of the sixteen dyes a channel can be set to. From 1 to 16. |
| Face modes | What pressing a face goes through, in order. Empty keeps Off, In, Out, Both. Each row has: Name, Colour, Does. |
| Players set each face | A player right-clicks a face with an empty hand and sets what it does on that placed block alone. The table is where every placed block starts. |
| Face screen | The screen a player opens by right-clicking a face of the placed block, laid out on the Face screen tab. Until it is changed there, the product draws its own rows. |
| Items a face filters | How many items a player can mark on a face, to let only those through or to keep them out. A mark is not the item: nothing is taken from the player. From 0 to 9. |
| Filter of your own | A piece of your own code that answers yes or no for each item, asked on every face beside the marks, for what the marks cannot say: damage, data, a stock level. |
| Speed upgrade | An item a player puts into a face's upgrade slot on its screen. Each one moves that face's rate again, eight at most; they drop when the block is broken. |
| Reserve room for items | An item riding through this pipe holds its place in the chest or machine it is going to, so two stacks never fight for one slot and nothing has to turn round. Turn it off and a stack just goes to the nearest place with room right now. |
| Item to link a chest | Pick an item and this block becomes a node that reaches a chest or machine without a cable. A player right-clicks the chest with the item, then right-clicks this block with it, and the network uses that chest as if it stood against the top of this block. Sneak and right-click the block to cut the link. Leave empty for a plain block. |
| How far a link reaches | The most blocks between this node and the chest it is linked to, in the same dimension. 0 means any distance. From 0 to 1024 blocks. |
| When it is broken | A block that carries more than one thing (items and fluid and energy, say) can come apart one thing at a time: mining it takes off the one added last and leaves the rest standing. Sneaking while you mine breaks the whole block. Choose one of: The whole block goes, One piece at a time. |
| Item for the items piece | What drops when the items part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Item for the fluid piece | What drops when the fluid part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Item for the energy piece | What drops when the energy part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Holds parts | Face parts go on its faces, one a face and one in the middle, and covers take another block's look. A face with no part joins only blocks of this mod, never a chest. |
| Moves by itself | Its out sides push into the blocks beside them and its in sides pull from them, with no pipe between: a machine filling the chest next to it, a block emptying a cart in front of it. Works for items, fluids, energy and your own stocks. Choose one of: No, Pushes out, Pulls in, Pushes and pulls. |
| How much a second | How much it moves each second through each side: items, or the units of a fluid, energy or stock. From 1 to 100000 perSecond. |
| Holds a cart | Stops the cart that rolls up beside it while it works, so the cart stays until the block has moved all it can, or until a rule lets it go. Needs Moves by itself. Choose one of: No, Until it has nothing more to move, Until a rule lets it go. |
| Longest it holds | The most seconds it holds one cart, so a cart is never kept for good. 0 holds as long as it takes. From 0 to 86400 seconds. |
| Destroys what none take | What no other block on its pipes takes is destroyed here, after every other block had its turn. Marks on its sides say what it destroys; with none, everything. |
| Fills a block | Whether its sides fill a block whenever it has room, or only while it holds none of what comes (one stack in each furnace, never two). Choose one of: Whenever it has room, Only when it holds none. |
| Stands in for a far block | Linked to a far chest or machine with the linking item, this block is that chest to hoppers, pipes and other mods: what goes in here goes there, and what is taken from here comes from there. |
| Joins without a seam | Where an arm of this block meets one of these, neither draws the end of its arm, so a run of them reads as one tube. A machine or a chest it meets keeps its end and its plate. Choose one of: As its pictures say, Blocks like it, Every cable or pipe it joins, Nothing. |

Every block also has the settings on the [Block](editor-block.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Energy, Connections.

## What it works with

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-capsule

# Capsule

An item that takes a box of blocks round the block it is used on, chests with their items too, and places it back wherever it is used next, showing a ghost first.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Capsule


## What you can set

### Captures

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Takes | Blocks (with their contents), or a creature with all it is. Choose one of: Blocks, A creature. |
| When taken | Move lifts the blocks out and places them back once; Copy leaves them and builds a copy from the player's items. Choose one of: Move them, Copy them. |
| Which blocks | A box round the block used on, or between two corners (sneak and use on the first). Choose one of: A box round the block, Between two corners. |
| Width | How many blocks across, centred on the block used on. From 1 to 31 blocks. |
| Height | How many blocks high, from the block used on up. From 1 to 31 blocks. |
| Most blocks | It refuses a box with more blocks than this. From 1 to 32768. |
| Contents go too | A chest keeps its items and a machine its data. Off, they come back empty. |
| Mobs go too | Mobs inside the box are taken with the blocks. |
| Places | Only where all of it fits, where there is room, or over what stands there. Choose one of: Only if all fits, Where there is room, Over what stands. |
| Takes unbreakable | Takes blocks that cannot be broken, like bedrock. |
| Never takes | Blocks and groups it leaves where they are; at first, the blocks no mod may move. |
| Which creatures | Mobs and groups of mobs it may catch, such as cats; empty catches any but bosses. |
| Only your own | Catches only pets the player has tamed. |
| Turns with you | What it places is turned as far as you turned since it took it. |
| Shows a ghost | While held, a see-through ghost shows where it will place; red where there is no room. |
| Builds a second | How many blocks a copy builds each second. From 1 to 400. |
| Each use takes | An item taken from the player each use, such as an ender pearl; empty is free. |
| Cooldown | Seconds before it can be used again. From 0 to 600 seconds. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-carvedBlock

# Carved block

A block made of small pieces of any block's look, carved on its Carve tab or by players in the world. Its boxes can be doors, seats, ladders, lights or stores; its item keeps the shape.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Carved block


## What you can set

### Made of small pieces

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Starts as | The block whose look a new one is made of, before anyone carves it. |
| First shape | A whole block, or the shape of its own model: as pieces, or as boxes of the model's exact sizes. Choose one of: A whole block, Its model, as pieces, Its model, as boxes, The shape carved on its Carve tab. |
| Carved shape | The shape it is placed with, carved piece by piece on its Carve tab: its looks, its pieces and its boxes. |
| Pieces to a side | How fine the carving is. Fewer pieces to a side make each cut bigger. Choose one of: Sixteen, Eight, Four, Two. |
| Carves the world's blocks | A carving tool used on a plain block in the world turns it into one of these, in that block's look. |
| Looks it takes | The blocks whose look its pieces may have. Empty takes every whole, solid block. |
| Its light | The light it gives: the light of the look most of its pieces have, the brightest of them, or none. Choose one of: Most of its pieces, The brightest piece, None. |
| Rows of a store | How many rows of nine slots a box that is a store opens with. From 1 to 6. |
| Carvings to undo | How many of a player's last carvings can be undone, one at a time. From 0 to 256. |
| Ladder speed | How fast a player climbs a box that is a ladder. From 0.5 to 20 blocksPerSecond. |
| Swing time | How many seconds a door takes to open or shut. Nought makes it jump in one step. From 0 to 10 seconds. |
| Opens with a redstone signal | A redstone signal next to the block opens its door, and no signal shuts it, as a normal door does. |
| Moves blocks around it | For a door bigger than one block: the carved blocks touching it with the same door name move together as one door. |
| Door name | Blocks that touch and share this name are one door. |
| How it moves | Swing turns the whole door round its hinge. Slide pushes it along. Choose one of: Swing, Slide. |
| Slide distance | How many blocks a sliding door moves. From 1 to 16 blocks. |
| Slide direction | Which way a sliding door moves when it opens. Choose one of: Up, Down, North, South, East, West. |

Every block also has the settings on the [Block](editor-block.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Made of small pieces.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-carvingTool

# Carving tool

A chisel or any tool that carves small pieces out of blocks or adds them, in one piece or a shape: a line, a flat square, a cube, a ball and more.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Carving tool


## What you can set

### Carves small pieces

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| It | What a use does to the block it is used on. Choose one of: Takes pieces away, Adds pieces, Swaps one look for another, Paints pieces, Places a box, Gives boxes a behaviour, Turns blocks into one. |
| Carving shape | The shape of what one use carves. Used in the air, the tool goes on to the next shape. Choose one of: One piece, A line, A flat square, A cube, A ball, A stretched ball, A cone, A tube, A wedge, A pyramid. |
| Carving size | How many pieces across the shape is when the tool is made. Crouching in the air changes it. From 1 to 16. |
| Largest size | The largest size a player can change it to. From 1 to 16. |
| Shape changes in the game | A use in the air goes on to the next shape. Off, the tool keeps the one shape it was made with. |
| Look it puts | The look of the pieces or boxes it adds. Empty: the look the player picks by crouching on a block. |
| Shapes it goes through | The shapes a use in the air goes through, in order. None chosen is every shape. Choose one of: One piece, A line, A flat square, A cube, A ball, A stretched ball, A cone, A tube, A wedge, A pyramid. |
| Looks it may put | The blocks whose look it may add, swap or paint. Empty: any look. |
| Blocks it carves | The plain blocks of the world it may carve into small pieces. Empty: every block a carved block takes. |
| Costs pieces | In survival, pieces taken away go into a bag of pieces and pieces added come out of one. In creative nothing is spent. |
| Box width | How wide a placed box is, in pixels of a block. A pixel is a sixteenth of a block, and a quarter of one is allowed. From 0.25 to 16. |
| Box height | How tall a placed box is, in pixels of a block. From 0.25 to 16. |
| Box depth | How deep a placed box is, in pixels of a block. From 0.25 to 16. |
| Box steps | Where a box may go: its corner lands on a step of this many pixels. From 0.0625 to 16. |
| Behaviour | What a box does: a seat to sit on, a ladder to climb, a light, a store that opens, or a door that opens and closes. Choose one of: Nothing, A seat, A ladder, A light, A store, A door. |
| Blocks to a side | How many placed blocks across it turns into one carved block, starting at the block used on. Choose one of: Two, Four, Eight, Sixteen. |

### Wears out

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Uses before it breaks | How many blocks it mines, hits it lands or hits it takes before it breaks: iron 250, diamond 1561. From 1 to 100000. |
| Mended with | What mends it in an anvil, such as an iron ingot, or one of this mod's own things. |
| Comes enchanted with | Enchantments it has from the first time a player holds it, the game's own or your own, each at its level. Each row has: Enchantment, Level. |
| Enchants how well | How good the enchantments it is offered are: iron 14, diamond 10, gold 22. From 0 to 50. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Carves small pieces, Wears out.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-carver

# Caves

Caves, ravines or Nether tunnels the world cuts into its ground. Give them to your biomes.

## How to add it

- New thing > The world > Caves


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Caves](editor-carver.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | What you call it here. The game never shows it. |
| Game name | The cave's name in the game, as a biome finds it. |
| Shape | Round tunnels, one long deep crack, or tunnels like the Nether's. Choose one of: Tunnels, A long crack, Nether tunnels. |
| How often | The chance, in each part of the world, that this cave starts there. From 0 to 100 percent. |
| How wide | How wide it is, as a multiple of the game's own. 1 is the usual width. From 0.2 to 5. |
| How tall | How tall it is, as a multiple of the game's own. 1 is the usual height. From 0.2 to 5. |
| From height | The lowest height it starts at. Sea level is 63. From -64 to 320 blocks. |
| To height | The highest height it starts at. From -64 to 320 blocks. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is not part of the game itself: it describes another mod or a file, so it has no side to choose.
