# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-matterPipe

# Matter pipe

A pipe that carries a matter of your own from the blocks that give it to the blocks that take it, holding none itself.

## How to add it

- New thing > Machines and networks > Matter pipe


## What you can set

### Matter

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Holds | The one matter it holds, refusing any other; left empty it holds any, one kind at a time. |
| Most it holds | How much of it the block holds at most. From 0 to 1000000000. |
| Most a second | How much of it moves in or out each second. From 0 to 1000000000. |
| No limit | On: matter cross this block as fast as the blocks at both ends can give and take. The number above is ignored. |
| Only this type | One type of its kind alone, by name, refusing the others: a jar of fire. Left empty, any type of the kind. |
| Labelled by | An item that, used on it, keeps it to the type it holds even when it is emptied. Used while crouching, the label comes off. |
| Tanks of stock | Tanks beside its own, each of a kind or one type, reached through the sides you pick: a machine taking water in and giving two gases out by two sides. Each row has: Holds, Only this type, Most it holds, Reached from, Pipes. |
| Turns items into | Items put in it become what they hold of this kind's types, one at a time, while its tanks have room for all of it: a log into tree and earth. |
| Seconds an item | How long it takes to turn one item. From 0.05 to 3600 seconds. |
| Into first types | A type made of others comes out as the types it is made of, each as much. |
| Lets through only | The types or kinds that may pass it, by name and split by commas. Put an exclamation mark in front of one to let all but it through. |

### Connections

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Faces | Which of the six faces connect, and to what. Open the Connections tab to set them. |
| What arrives | A cable or a pipe passes it on and holds nothing. A machine, a tank or a battery keeps it. Choose one of: It keeps it, It passes it on. |
| Served before others | When several blocks want the same thing and there is not enough, the higher number is filled first. Equal numbers take turns. From -64 to 64. |
| Serves first | Whom what leaves it goes to first, for items, fluids and every stock: shared by priority, each block in turn, or the nearest along the pipes. Choose one of: By priority, Each in turn, The nearest. |
| Faces have colours | A coloured face joins only faces of its colour. Off, faces ignore colour. |
| Dyes a face steps through | How many of the sixteen dyes a channel can be set to. From 1 to 16. |
| Face modes | What pressing a face goes through, in order. Empty keeps Off, In, Out, Both. Each row has: Name, Colour, Does. |
| Players set each face | A player right-clicks a face with an empty hand and sets what it does on that placed block alone. The table is where every placed block starts. |
| Face screen | The screen a player opens by right-clicking a face of the placed block, laid out on the Face screen tab. Until it is changed there, the product draws its own rows. |
| Items a face filters | How many items a player can mark on a face, to let only those through or to keep them out. A mark is not the item: nothing is taken from the player. From 0 to 9. |
| Filter of your own | A piece of your own code that answers yes or no for each item, asked on every face beside the marks, for what the marks cannot say: damage, data, a stock level. |
| Speed upgrade | An item a player puts into a face's upgrade slot on its screen. Each one moves that face's rate again, eight at most; they drop when the block is broken. |
| Reserve room for items | An item riding through this pipe holds its place in the chest or machine it is going to, so two stacks never fight for one slot and nothing has to turn round. Turn it off and a stack just goes to the nearest place with room right now. |
| Item to link a chest | Pick an item and this block becomes a node that reaches a chest or machine without a cable. A player right-clicks the chest with the item, then right-clicks this block with it, and the network uses that chest as if it stood against the top of this block. Sneak and right-click the block to cut the link. Leave empty for a plain block. |
| How far a link reaches | The most blocks between this node and the chest it is linked to, in the same dimension. 0 means any distance. From 0 to 1024 blocks. |
| When it is broken | A block that carries more than one thing (items and fluid and energy, say) can come apart one thing at a time: mining it takes off the one added last and leaves the rest standing. Sneaking while you mine breaks the whole block. Choose one of: The whole block goes, One piece at a time. |
| Item for the items piece | What drops when the items part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Item for the fluid piece | What drops when the fluid part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Item for the energy piece | What drops when the energy part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Holds parts | Face parts go on its faces, one a face and one in the middle, and covers take another block's look. A face with no part joins only blocks of this mod, never a chest. |
| Moves by itself | Its out sides push into the blocks beside them and its in sides pull from them, with no pipe between: a machine filling the chest next to it, a block emptying a cart in front of it. Works for items, fluids, energy and your own stocks. Choose one of: No, Pushes out, Pulls in, Pushes and pulls. |
| How much a second | How much it moves each second through each side: items, or the units of a fluid, energy or stock. From 1 to 100000 perSecond. |
| Holds a cart | Stops the cart that rolls up beside it while it works, so the cart stays until the block has moved all it can, or until a rule lets it go. Needs Moves by itself. Choose one of: No, Until it has nothing more to move, Until a rule lets it go. |
| Longest it holds | The most seconds it holds one cart, so a cart is never kept for good. 0 holds as long as it takes. From 0 to 86400 seconds. |
| Destroys what none take | What no other block on its pipes takes is destroyed here, after every other block had its turn. Marks on its sides say what it destroys; with none, everything. |
| Fills a block | Whether its sides fill a block whenever it has room, or only while it holds none of what comes (one stack in each furnace, never two). Choose one of: Whenever it has room, Only when it holds none. |
| Stands in for a far block | Linked to a far chest or machine with the linking item, this block is that chest to hoppers, pipes and other mods: what goes in here goes there, and what is taken from here comes from there. |
| Joins without a seam | Where an arm of this block meets one of these, neither draws the end of its arm, so a run of them reads as one tube. A machine or a chest it meets keeps its end and its plate. Choose one of: As its pictures say, Blocks like it, Every cable or pipe it joins, Nothing. |

Every block also has the settings on the [Block](editor-block.md) page.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-matterTank

# Matter tank

A block that holds a matter of your own and joins pipes of it on every side: a chemical tank, a mana pool, a store of heat.

## How to add it

- New thing > Machines and networks > Matter tank


## What you can set

### Matter

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Holds | The one matter it holds, refusing any other; left empty it holds any, one kind at a time. |
| Most it holds | How much of it the block holds at most. From 0 to 1000000000. |
| Most a second | How much of it moves in or out each second. From 0 to 1000000000. |
| No limit | On: matter cross this block as fast as the blocks at both ends can give and take. The number above is ignored. |
| Only this type | One type of its kind alone, by name, refusing the others: a jar of fire. Left empty, any type of the kind. |
| Labelled by | An item that, used on it, keeps it to the type it holds even when it is emptied. Used while crouching, the label comes off. |
| Tanks of stock | Tanks beside its own, each of a kind or one type, reached through the sides you pick: a machine taking water in and giving two gases out by two sides. Each row has: Holds, Only this type, Most it holds, Reached from, Pipes. |
| Turns items into | Items put in it become what they hold of this kind's types, one at a time, while its tanks have room for all of it: a log into tree and earth. |
| Seconds an item | How long it takes to turn one item. From 0.05 to 3600 seconds. |
| Into first types | A type made of others comes out as the types it is made of, each as much. |
| Lets through only | The types or kinds that may pass it, by name and split by commas. Put an exclamation mark in front of one to let all but it through. |

### Connections

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Faces | Which of the six faces connect, and to what. Open the Connections tab to set them. |
| What arrives | A cable or a pipe passes it on and holds nothing. A machine, a tank or a battery keeps it. Choose one of: It keeps it, It passes it on. |
| Served before others | When several blocks want the same thing and there is not enough, the higher number is filled first. Equal numbers take turns. From -64 to 64. |
| Serves first | Whom what leaves it goes to first, for items, fluids and every stock: shared by priority, each block in turn, or the nearest along the pipes. Choose one of: By priority, Each in turn, The nearest. |
| Faces have colours | A coloured face joins only faces of its colour. Off, faces ignore colour. |
| Dyes a face steps through | How many of the sixteen dyes a channel can be set to. From 1 to 16. |
| Face modes | What pressing a face goes through, in order. Empty keeps Off, In, Out, Both. Each row has: Name, Colour, Does. |
| Players set each face | A player right-clicks a face with an empty hand and sets what it does on that placed block alone. The table is where every placed block starts. |
| Face screen | The screen a player opens by right-clicking a face of the placed block, laid out on the Face screen tab. Until it is changed there, the product draws its own rows. |
| Items a face filters | How many items a player can mark on a face, to let only those through or to keep them out. A mark is not the item: nothing is taken from the player. From 0 to 9. |
| Filter of your own | A piece of your own code that answers yes or no for each item, asked on every face beside the marks, for what the marks cannot say: damage, data, a stock level. |
| Speed upgrade | An item a player puts into a face's upgrade slot on its screen. Each one moves that face's rate again, eight at most; they drop when the block is broken. |
| Reserve room for items | An item riding through this pipe holds its place in the chest or machine it is going to, so two stacks never fight for one slot and nothing has to turn round. Turn it off and a stack just goes to the nearest place with room right now. |
| Item to link a chest | Pick an item and this block becomes a node that reaches a chest or machine without a cable. A player right-clicks the chest with the item, then right-clicks this block with it, and the network uses that chest as if it stood against the top of this block. Sneak and right-click the block to cut the link. Leave empty for a plain block. |
| How far a link reaches | The most blocks between this node and the chest it is linked to, in the same dimension. 0 means any distance. From 0 to 1024 blocks. |
| When it is broken | A block that carries more than one thing (items and fluid and energy, say) can come apart one thing at a time: mining it takes off the one added last and leaves the rest standing. Sneaking while you mine breaks the whole block. Choose one of: The whole block goes, One piece at a time. |
| Item for the items piece | What drops when the items part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Item for the fluid piece | What drops when the fluid part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Item for the energy piece | What drops when the energy part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Holds parts | Face parts go on its faces, one a face and one in the middle, and covers take another block's look. A face with no part joins only blocks of this mod, never a chest. |
| Moves by itself | Its out sides push into the blocks beside them and its in sides pull from them, with no pipe between: a machine filling the chest next to it, a block emptying a cart in front of it. Works for items, fluids, energy and your own stocks. Choose one of: No, Pushes out, Pulls in, Pushes and pulls. |
| How much a second | How much it moves each second through each side: items, or the units of a fluid, energy or stock. From 1 to 100000 perSecond. |
| Holds a cart | Stops the cart that rolls up beside it while it works, so the cart stays until the block has moved all it can, or until a rule lets it go. Needs Moves by itself. Choose one of: No, Until it has nothing more to move, Until a rule lets it go. |
| Longest it holds | The most seconds it holds one cart, so a cart is never kept for good. 0 holds as long as it takes. From 0 to 86400 seconds. |
| Destroys what none take | What no other block on its pipes takes is destroyed here, after every other block had its turn. Marks on its sides say what it destroys; with none, everything. |
| Fills a block | Whether its sides fill a block whenever it has room, or only while it holds none of what comes (one stack in each furnace, never two). Choose one of: Whenever it has room, Only when it holds none. |
| Stands in for a far block | Linked to a far chest or machine with the linking item, this block is that chest to hoppers, pipes and other mods: what goes in here goes there, and what is taken from here comes from there. |
| Joins without a seam | Where an arm of this block meets one of these, neither draws the end of its arm, so a run of them reads as one tube. A machine or a chest it meets keeps its end and its plate. Choose one of: As its pictures say, Blocks like it, Every cable or pipe it joins, Nothing. |

Every block also has the settings on the [Block](editor-block.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Matter, Connections.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md), [Sound](editor-sound.md), [Particle](editor-particle.md), [Item](editor-item.md), [Code](editor-code.md).

Other things that open the same editor: [Block](thing-block.md), [Machine](thing-machine.md), [Generator](thing-generator.md), [Cable](thing-cable.md), [Pipe](thing-pipe.md), [Item pipe](thing-itemPipe.md), [Tank](thing-tank.md), [Transmitter](thing-wirelessTransmitter.md), [Receiver](thing-wirelessReceiver.md), [Wireless energy node](thing-wirelessNode.md), [Shared chest](thing-sharedChest.md), [Shared tank](thing-sharedTank.md), [Chest](thing-chest.md), [Drawer](thing-drawer.md), [Storage crate](thing-crate.md), [Mailbox](thing-mailbox.md), [Trade station](thing-tradeStation.md), [Asking chest](thing-askingChest.md), [Terminal](thing-terminal.md), [Storage cell](thing-storageCell.md), [Storage cable](thing-storageCable.md), [Drive](thing-drive.md), [Network heart](thing-networkHeart.md), [Dense cable](thing-denseCable.md), [Link](thing-storeLink.md), [Access point](thing-accessPoint.md), [Crafter](thing-crafter.md), [Pattern table](thing-patternTable.md), [Altar](thing-altar.md), [Pedestal](thing-pedestal.md), [Formed machine](thing-formedMachine.md), [Machine casing](thing-machineCasing.md), [Waypoint](thing-waypointBlock.md), [Aiming block](thing-aimingBlock.md), [Berry bush](thing-berryBush.md), [Matter pipe](thing-matterPipe.md), [Assembly station](thing-assemblyStation.md), [Carved block](thing-carvedBlock.md), [Ore](thing-ore.md), [Crop](thing-crop.md), [Plant](thing-plant.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-mixin

# Mixin

A piece of your own code that changes one of the game's classes, listed in your mixin config for you. It takes its name from this thing's name until you write in it.

## How to add it

- New thing > Logic and code > Mixin


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [File of your own](editor-ownFile.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | What you call it here. |
| File | Where it is: resources/common reaches every target, resources/neoforge and resources/fabric one each. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is not part of the game itself: it describes another mod or a file, so it has no side to choose.

## What it works with

It does not point at other things.

Other things that open the same editor: [File of your own](thing-ownFile.md), [Pack file](thing-packFile.md), [Dimension file of your own](thing-dimensionFile.md), [Look of a block made in code](thing-blockLook.md), [Mixin config](thing-mixinConfig.md), [Access widener (Fabric)](thing-accessWidener.md), [Access transformer (NeoForge)](thing-accessTransformer.md).

It is not part of the game itself: it describes another mod or a file, so it has no side to choose.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-mobBehaviour

# Mob behaviour

A piece of your own code that joins one activity of a mob's brain, the game's or another mod's.

## How to add it

- New thing > Mobs and models > Mob behaviour


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Mob behaviour](editor-mobBehaviour.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | What you call it in the project. |
| Mob | The mob, chosen from the game's mobs and your own. |
| Activity | The activity of its brain the behaviour joins, such as ram for a goat's charge. Choose one of: Always (core), Idle, Work, Play, Rest, Meet, Panic, Raid, Before a raid, Hide, Fight, Celebrate, Admire an item, Avoid, Ride, Play dead, Long jump, Ram, Tongue, Swim, Lay spawn, Sniff, Investigate, Roar, Emerge, Dig. |
| Priority | Where it runs among the activity's behaviours: a lower number first. |
| Behaviour class | Your class's full name; it is made once for each mob, with no arguments. |
| Conditions | When the activity may run, one a line: a memory and present, absent or registered, such as tempting_player absent. They stand in for the activity's own, so list the game's too. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is written into the mod when you [Cook](glossary.md#cook) or press [Play](glossary.md#play).

## What it works with

It does not point at other things.

## Picture

![Mob behaviour](/media/docs/editor-mobBehaviour.webp)

- [Mob behaviour](editor-mobBehaviour.md)
- [Templates and samples](templates-and-samples.md)

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-mobCatcher

# Mob catcher

An item that catches a creature with its name, health and everything it is, and lets it out again where it is used.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Mob catcher


## What you can set

### Captures

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Takes | Blocks (with their contents), or a creature with all it is. Choose one of: Blocks, A creature. |
| When taken | Move lifts the blocks out and places them back once; Copy leaves them and builds a copy from the player's items. Choose one of: Move them, Copy them. |
| Which blocks | A box round the block used on, or between two corners (sneak and use on the first). Choose one of: A box round the block, Between two corners. |
| Width | How many blocks across, centred on the block used on. From 1 to 31 blocks. |
| Height | How many blocks high, from the block used on up. From 1 to 31 blocks. |
| Most blocks | It refuses a box with more blocks than this. From 1 to 32768. |
| Contents go too | A chest keeps its items and a machine its data. Off, they come back empty. |
| Mobs go too | Mobs inside the box are taken with the blocks. |
| Places | Only where all of it fits, where there is room, or over what stands there. Choose one of: Only if all fits, Where there is room, Over what stands. |
| Takes unbreakable | Takes blocks that cannot be broken, like bedrock. |
| Never takes | Blocks and groups it leaves where they are; at first, the blocks no mod may move. |
| Which creatures | Mobs and groups of mobs it may catch, such as cats; empty catches any but bosses. |
| Only your own | Catches only pets the player has tamed. |
| Turns with you | What it places is turned as far as you turned since it took it. |
| Shows a ghost | While held, a see-through ghost shows where it will place; red where there is no room. |
| Builds a second | How many blocks a copy builds each second. From 1 to 400. |
| Each use takes | An item taken from the player each use, such as an ender pearl; empty is free. |
| Cooldown | Seconds before it can be used again. From 0 to 600 seconds. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Captures.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md).

Other things that open the same editor: [Item](thing-item.md), [Crate](thing-lootCrate.md), [Backpack](thing-backpack.md), [Settings copier](thing-settingsCopier.md), [Letter](thing-letter.md), [Pocket](thing-pocket.md), [Storage disk](thing-storageDisk.md), [Disk for fluids](thing-fluidDisk.md), [Wireless terminal](thing-wirelessTerminal.md), [Upgrade](thing-upgrade.md), [Structure finder](thing-structureFinder.md), [Pointer](thing-pointer.md), [Designator](thing-designator.md), [Item filter](thing-itemFilter.md), [Configurator](thing-configurator.md), [Face part](thing-facePart.md), [Waypoint compass](thing-waypointCompass.md), [Spell wand](thing-spellWand.md), [Spell book](thing-spellBook.md), [Spell scroll](thing-spellScroll.md), [Tool](thing-tool.md), [Weapon](thing-weapon.md), [Armor](thing-armour.md), [Food](thing-food.md), [Fuel](thing-fuel.md), [Bow](thing-bow.md), [Crossbow](thing-crossbow.md), [Shield](thing-shield.md), [Part](thing-part.md), [Tool of parts](thing-partsTool.md), [Golem-style creature](thing-partsCreature.md), [Battery](thing-battery.md), [Powered tool](thing-poweredTool.md), [Powered armour](thing-poweredArmour.md), [Building wand](thing-buildingWand.md), [Copy wand](thing-copyWand.md), [Capsule](thing-capsule.md), [Building plan](thing-buildingPlan.md), [Carving tool](thing-carvingTool.md), [Bag of pieces](thing-bitBag.md), [Shape pattern](thing-shapePattern.md), [Tree axe](thing-treeAxe.md), [Vein pickaxe](thing-veinPickaxe.md), [Module](thing-module.md), [Building tool](thing-builder.md), [Thrown weapon](thing-thrown.md), [Music disc](thing-musicDisc.md), [Shears](thing-shears.md), [Fishing rod](thing-fishingRod.md), [Tool for everything](thing-multiTool.md), [Hat](thing-hat.md), [Vehicle part](thing-vehiclePart.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-configValue

# Mod settings

A setting players can change after the mod is built, in its settings file: a number, on or off, one word out of a list, or a list of entries they edit.

## How to add it

- New thing > Logic and code > Mod settings


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Mod settings](editor-configValue.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | What the setting is called in the config screen. |
| Key in the file | The name of the setting in the settings file: letters, digits and underscores. |
| Type | What the setting holds: a whole number, a decimal such as a chance, on or off, one word out of a list you make, or a list of entries each with a few fields. Choose one of: Whole number, Decimal, On or off, A choice of words, A list of entries, Text. |
| Text | The words it holds until a player changes it. |
| Longest allowed | The most letters the settings file accepts. 0 means any length. |
| Value | What it is until a player changes it. |
| Lowest allowed | The settings file refuses anything below this. |
| Highest allowed | The settings file refuses anything above this. |
| On | Whether it is on until a player changes it. |
| Words | The words a player may choose from: small letters, digits and _. |
| Chosen | The word it is until a player changes it. |
| Which file | Common is one file for everyone; client is each player's own; server lives with the world. Choose one of: Common, Client, Server. |
| Each entry has | The fields every entry of the list has, each with its name in the file and what it holds. Each row has: Field, Holds. |
| Entries | The entries the file starts with, one a line, each field as name=value with ; between them. The player adds, changes and takes away entries in the file. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is written into the mod when you [Cook](glossary.md#cook) or press [Play](glossary.md#play).

## What it works with

It does not point at other things.

## Picture

![Mod settings](/media/docs/editor-configValue.webp)

## Related pages

- [Mod settings](editor-configValue.md)
- [Templates and samples](templates-and-samples.md)
- [Glossary](glossary.md)

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-model

# Model

The shape of a block, item or mob, made from boxes.

## How to add it

- New thing > Mobs and models > Model


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Model](editor-model.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | What this shape is called in the product. It is not shown in the game. |
| Game name | The name the game files use for this model, in small letters with no spaces. The Name above is only for you. |
| Shape | The boxes and groups this shape is made of. Open the Model tab to build it. |
| Its pictures are | How the game draws what is clear in the pictures. Solid ignores it. With holes leaves a clear pixel out, as the game's own glass does. See-through draws each pixel as clear as it was painted, so what is inside can be seen. Choose one of: Solid, With holes, See-through. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is written into the mod when you [Cook](glossary.md#cook) or press [Play](glossary.md#play).

## What it works with

It does not point at other things.

Other things that open the same editor: [Skin](thing-skin.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-module

# Module

Something installed into a tool or armour that takes modules, switching an ability on and spending its energy.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Module


## What you can set

### Module

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Goes into | What it can be installed into. Choose one of: Anything that takes modules, A tool, A weapon, Armor, Something that holds items. |
| Gains levels by | How it goes up a level: put in again (each time one more level), or by what the one wearing or holding it does. Choose one of: Putting it in again, What the player does. |
| Counts | What the player does that counts toward its next level while the thing it goes into is worn or held. Choose one of: Blocks run, Blocks walked, Blocks swum, Blocks flown, Blocks fallen, Jumps, Damage taken, Damage dealt, Mobs killed, Blocks mined, Seconds worn. |
| For each level | How much of what it counts makes one more level: 100 blocks run is level 1, 200 is level 2, up to its most levels and the room the thing has for it. From 1 to 100000000. |
| Energy each use | What it spends of the item's energy each block mined or hit, or each second while worn; nought and it costs nothing. From 0 to 1000000000. |
| Changes the tool | What it changes of the item it is installed in while switched on, each level once more: any stat, the game's or a material's own. Each row has: Stat, How, Amount, Only on blocks. |
| Most levels | Installed again it goes up a level, to this many. From 1 to 100. |
| Slots a level | How many of the host's slots each level takes. From 0 to 54. |
| Put in by hand | Used while the thing it goes into is in the other hand, it goes in (a gem into a socket). That thing used crouching with the other hand empty gives the last one back. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Module.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md).

Other things that open the same editor: [Item](thing-item.md), [Crate](thing-lootCrate.md), [Backpack](thing-backpack.md), [Settings copier](thing-settingsCopier.md), [Letter](thing-letter.md), [Pocket](thing-pocket.md), [Storage disk](thing-storageDisk.md), [Disk for fluids](thing-fluidDisk.md), [Wireless terminal](thing-wirelessTerminal.md), [Upgrade](thing-upgrade.md), [Structure finder](thing-structureFinder.md), [Pointer](thing-pointer.md), [Designator](thing-designator.md), [Item filter](thing-itemFilter.md), [Configurator](thing-configurator.md), [Face part](thing-facePart.md), [Waypoint compass](thing-waypointCompass.md), [Spell wand](thing-spellWand.md), [Spell book](thing-spellBook.md), [Spell scroll](thing-spellScroll.md), [Tool](thing-tool.md), [Weapon](thing-weapon.md), [Armor](thing-armour.md), [Food](thing-food.md), [Fuel](thing-fuel.md), [Bow](thing-bow.md), [Crossbow](thing-crossbow.md), [Shield](thing-shield.md), [Part](thing-part.md), [Tool of parts](thing-partsTool.md), [Golem-style creature](thing-partsCreature.md), [Battery](thing-battery.md), [Powered tool](thing-poweredTool.md), [Powered armour](thing-poweredArmour.md), [Building wand](thing-buildingWand.md), [Copy wand](thing-copyWand.md), [Capsule](thing-capsule.md), [Building plan](thing-buildingPlan.md), [Mob catcher](thing-mobCatcher.md), [Carving tool](thing-carvingTool.md), [Bag of pieces](thing-bitBag.md), [Shape pattern](thing-shapePattern.md), [Tree axe](thing-treeAxe.md), [Vein pickaxe](thing-veinPickaxe.md), [Building tool](thing-builder.md), [Thrown weapon](thing-thrown.md), [Music disc](thing-musicDisc.md), [Shears](thing-shears.md), [Fishing rod](thing-fishingRod.md), [Tool for everything](thing-multiTool.md), [Hat](thing-hat.md), [Vehicle part](thing-vehiclePart.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-mount

# Mount

A mob tamed by riding it until it calms, then saddled, ridden and given bags and armour.

## How to add it

- New thing > Mobs and models > Mount


## What you can set

### Has a spawn egg

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Egg colour | The colour of the egg itself. |
| Spot colour | The colour of the spots on the egg. |

### Can be tamed

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Tamed by | What makes it a player's: an item given to it, riding it until it calms, or only a rule's words. Choose one of: Giving it an item, Riding it until it calms, Only a rule. |
| Tamed with | The item a player gives it, one each try. |
| Chance a try | How likely each item given, or each time it is ridden, tames it. From 1 to 100 percent. |
| Sits when told | Its owner's use makes it sit and stay, and stand again. |
| Follows owner | It keeps near its owner when it is not sitting. |
| Follows from | How far its owner may go before it comes after them. From 2 to 32 blocks. |
| Catches up | Left far behind, it appears beside its owner, as a tame wolf does. |
| Strikes back at its owner | Off, a tamed one never targets or attacks its owner or the owner's team, however it was hurt, as a wolf does not. |
| Defends owner | It attacks what hurts its owner and what its owner attacks. |
| Healed with | Foods its owner gives it to heal it. |

### Can be ridden

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Flies ridden | How it flies with a rider: the jump key rises, the sprint key (Ctrl) descends, forward goes where the rider looks, A and D turn it; hovering and flapping hold their height when no key is held, gliding sinks slowly. Choose one of: Does not fly, Glides, Hovers, Flaps, Its own way. |
| Climbs at | How fast it rises while its rider holds jump. From 0 to 40 blocks a second. |
| Sinks at | How fast it sinks in the air with nothing held. 0: it hovers. From 0 to 40 blocks a second. |
| Dives at | How fast it goes down while its rider holds the descend key. From 0 to 40 blocks a second. |
| In water | Floating keeps its rider's head up; swimming dives and rises where the rider looks, and the rider breathes. Choose one of: Floats, Swims under. |
| Needs a saddle | It can be ridden only once a saddle is put on it. |
| Saddle | The item used on it as its saddle. |
| Ridden by | Only its owner once it is tamed, or anyone. Choose one of: Its owner, Anyone. |
| Speed ridden | How fast it goes with a rider, times its own speed. From 0.1 to 5 times. |
| Flying speed | How fast it flies with a rider, times its own flying speed. From 0.1 to 5 times. |
| Jumps | How high it jumps on a full charge of the jump bar. From 0 to 8 blocks. |
| Seat height | How far above or below its back the rider sits; the back is found from the shape of its body. From -4 to 8 blocks. |
| A and D | Turning turns the creature and the rider's view with it, as a horse does; strafing moves it sideways and keeps it facing. Choose one of: Turn it, Strafe, Nothing. |
| Mouse look | Steering, the creature faces where the rider looks, as a vanilla horse does; looking only, the view turns on its own and the creature faces where A and D turned it. Choose one of: Steers it, Looks only. |
| W and S | Forward and back move it along its body; set to nothing, only the other keys move it. Choose one of: Move it, Nothing. |
| Jump key | Auto rises a flier or a swimmer and makes the others jump with the jump bar; or choose to rise, to jump, or nothing. Choose one of: Auto, Rise, Jump, Nothing. |
| Free up and down | A flier or a swimmer rises while the jump key is held, holds its height when nothing is held, and descends on the sprint key. Off, it goes up and down only where the rider looks. |
| Descend key | The key held to take a flier or a swimmer down (changed in the game's Controls); the sneak key always gets the rider off. Choose one of: Sprint key (Ctrl), Swap-hands key (F), None. |
| Rider on a tilt | Following, the rider leans with the seat's part of the body as it tilts (a dragon pitched in flight); upright, he stays level whatever the body does. First person stays level either way. Choose one of: Follows the seat, Stays upright. |
| Rider can hit it | A left click while riding never lands on the creature itself unless this is on. |
| Falls hurt | Off, neither the rider nor the creature takes fall damage while riding, and the rider none from the fall off its back. |
| Seat forward | How far forward of the middle of its back the rider sits; below zero is behind. From -4 to 4 blocks. |
| Turn speed | How fast A and D turn it, and the rider's view with it, in degrees a second. From 10 to 360 degrees a second. |
| Seats | How many ride it at once; the first steers. From 1 to 4. |

### Carries gear

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Bags | Rows of nine slots its owner opens by sneaking and using it; none for no bags. From 0 to 6. |
| Armour it wears | Items put on it as armour, each with what it gives and the look it wears with it. Each row has: Item, Armour, Toughness, Look. |

### Habits

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Looks at | What its head turns to follow. Choose one of: What it fights, Players near, Its owner, Nothing. |
| Follows a player holding | It walks up to a player holding one of these, as a cow follows wheat. |
| Fights | When it goes after what its temperament makes it fight. Choose one of: Always, Only at night, Only by day, Only when hit. |
| Sleeps | It lies still, waking when hurt; a state named Sleeping plays while it sleeps. Choose one of: Never, At night, By day. |
| Keeps with | Whether it wanders alone, keeps near others of its kind, follows one of them as their leader, or moves as one with them in a swarm, each its spacing apart. Choose one of: Nobody, Its herd, A leader, A swarm. |
| Spacing | How far apart the swarm keeps, in blocks. Each one keeps its own place round the eldest, so the group moves as one. From 0.25 to 16 blocks. |
| Avoids | What it keeps away from, and how fast it runs from it. Each row has: What, Keeps away, Runs at. |
| Grazes on | Blocks it eats where it stands, as a sheep eats grass, healing. |
| Eats from the ground | Items lying near that it goes to and eats, healing. |
| Flees under | Hurt below this share of its health, it runs from what hurt it; none never. From 0 to 100 percent. |
| Head turns | How far its head turns from its body, either way. From 10 to 180 degrees. |
| Babies follow | A baby keeps near a grown one of its kind. |
| Heals by | How much eating heals it. From 0 to 100 halfHearts. |

Every mob also has the settings on the [Mob](editor-creature.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Has a spawn egg, Can be tamed, Can be ridden, Carries gear, Habits.

## What it works with

Other things that open the same editor: [Mob](thing-creature.md), [Pet](thing-pet.md), [Flying mount](thing-flyingMount.md), [Sea mount](thing-seaMount.md), [Boss](thing-boss.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-movement

# Movement

How a living thing moves, the player or a mob: its speed and its jump, and a class of yours run as it moves.

## How to add it

- New thing > Mobs and models > Movement


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Movement](editor-movement.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | What you call it in the project. |
| Living thing | Choose a mob, or a group of them such as the undead. |
| Speed | How fast it walks, as a share of its own; 1 is its own. From 0 to 20 normal. |
| Jump | How strongly it jumps, as a share of its own; 1 is its own. From 0 to 20 normal. |
| Each tick class | Your class's full name, or empty. It implements the mod's Movements.EachTick and runs every tick for each of them, a mob's on the server and the player's on its own client, where it may change its motion. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is not part of the game itself: it describes another mod or a file, so it has no side to choose.

## What it works with

It does not point at other things.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-networkHeart

# Network heart

The block a storage network can need to work. It hands out channels and can use power.

## How to add it

- New thing > Machines and networks > Network heart


## What you can set

### Inventory

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Slots | How many stacks it holds, up to 256. Past six rows, its screen scrolls them or shows them all, as Screen shows says. From 1 to 256. |
| Screen shows | How its screen lays out more rows than six, until you lay it out on the Screen tab: six rows and a bar that scrolls the rest, or every slot at once in a screen grown to fit them. Choose one of: Six rows and a scroll bar, The whole grid at once. |
| Slots across | How many slots a row of its screen holds, 1 to 24. Past nine, the screen grows wider. From 1 to 24. |
| Items per slot | The most of one thing a slot takes. The game reads it live, so a mod setting can stand in. From 1 to 64. |
| Most a second | The most that moves in or out of it each second along a network. Hoppers keep their own speed. From 1 to 1024. |
| No limit | On: items cross this block as fast as the blocks at both ends can give and take. The number above is ignored. |
| Items travel at | How fast an item crosses this block on a pipe that passes items on. At nought an item arrives the moment the network moves it. Above nought it takes time to cross, pipe by pipe, and each pipe holds and keeps what is inside it. From 0 to 20 blocksPerSecond. |
| Shares the cards in it | Every value card put in it gives its value by its name, to the whole world or to the cable network it sits on, so a reader or a sum anywhere there can use the name. A card named in an anvil uses that name; otherwise the item's own. Choose one of: No, With the whole world, On its cable network. |
| Opens a screen | Used by hand, it opens its slots in a screen laid out on the Screen tab. |
| Takes back with | Empty hand: any empty hand takes the item back. Sneaking: only an empty hand while sneaking does. Choose one of: An empty hand, Sneaking, empty hand. |
| Put in and take out by hand | A block with no screen takes the stack in the player's hand when used, and gives it back to an empty hand (sneaking or not), as a lectern or a decorated pot does. Turn it off when only machines and commands fill it. |
| Screen | The machine's screen, laid out on the Screen tab. Until it is changed there, the product draws it from the slots and gauges. |

### Connections

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Faces | Which of the six faces connect, and to what. Open the Connections tab to set them. |
| What arrives | A cable or a pipe passes it on and holds nothing. A machine, a tank or a battery keeps it. Choose one of: It keeps it, It passes it on. |
| Served before others | When several blocks want the same thing and there is not enough, the higher number is filled first. Equal numbers take turns. From -64 to 64. |
| Serves first | Whom what leaves it goes to first, for items, fluids and every stock: shared by priority, each block in turn, or the nearest along the pipes. Choose one of: By priority, Each in turn, The nearest. |
| Faces have colours | A coloured face joins only faces of its colour. Off, faces ignore colour. |
| Dyes a face steps through | How many of the sixteen dyes a channel can be set to. From 1 to 16. |
| Face modes | What pressing a face goes through, in order. Empty keeps Off, In, Out, Both. Each row has: Name, Colour, Does. |
| Players set each face | A player right-clicks a face with an empty hand and sets what it does on that placed block alone. The table is where every placed block starts. |
| Face screen | The screen a player opens by right-clicking a face of the placed block, laid out on the Face screen tab. Until it is changed there, the product draws its own rows. |
| Items a face filters | How many items a player can mark on a face, to let only those through or to keep them out. A mark is not the item: nothing is taken from the player. From 0 to 9. |
| Filter of your own | A piece of your own code that answers yes or no for each item, asked on every face beside the marks, for what the marks cannot say: damage, data, a stock level. |
| Speed upgrade | An item a player puts into a face's upgrade slot on its screen. Each one moves that face's rate again, eight at most; they drop when the block is broken. |
| Reserve room for items | An item riding through this pipe holds its place in the chest or machine it is going to, so two stacks never fight for one slot and nothing has to turn round. Turn it off and a stack just goes to the nearest place with room right now. |
| Item to link a chest | Pick an item and this block becomes a node that reaches a chest or machine without a cable. A player right-clicks the chest with the item, then right-clicks this block with it, and the network uses that chest as if it stood against the top of this block. Sneak and right-click the block to cut the link. Leave empty for a plain block. |
| How far a link reaches | The most blocks between this node and the chest it is linked to, in the same dimension. 0 means any distance. From 0 to 1024 blocks. |
| When it is broken | A block that carries more than one thing (items and fluid and energy, say) can come apart one thing at a time: mining it takes off the one added last and leaves the rest standing. Sneaking while you mine breaks the whole block. Choose one of: The whole block goes, One piece at a time. |
| Item for the items piece | What drops when the items part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Item for the fluid piece | What drops when the fluid part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Item for the energy piece | What drops when the energy part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Holds parts | Face parts go on its faces, one a face and one in the middle, and covers take another block's look. A face with no part joins only blocks of this mod, never a chest. |
| Moves by itself | Its out sides push into the blocks beside them and its in sides pull from them, with no pipe between: a machine filling the chest next to it, a block emptying a cart in front of it. Works for items, fluids, energy and your own stocks. Choose one of: No, Pushes out, Pulls in, Pushes and pulls. |
| How much a second | How much it moves each second through each side: items, or the units of a fluid, energy or stock. From 1 to 100000 perSecond. |
| Holds a cart | Stops the cart that rolls up beside it while it works, so the cart stays until the block has moved all it can, or until a rule lets it go. Needs Moves by itself. Choose one of: No, Until it has nothing more to move, Until a rule lets it go. |
| Longest it holds | The most seconds it holds one cart, so a cart is never kept for good. 0 holds as long as it takes. From 0 to 86400 seconds. |
| Destroys what none take | What no other block on its pipes takes is destroyed here, after every other block had its turn. Marks on its sides say what it destroys; with none, everything. |
| Fills a block | Whether its sides fill a block whenever it has room, or only while it holds none of what comes (one stack in each furnace, never two). Choose one of: Whenever it has room, Only when it holds none. |
| Stands in for a far block | Linked to a far chest or machine with the linking item, this block is that chest to hoppers, pipes and other mods: what goes in here goes there, and what is taken from here comes from there. |
| Joins without a seam | Where an arm of this block meets one of these, neither draws the end of its arm, so a run of them reads as one tube. A machine or a chest it meets keeps its end and its plate. Choose one of: As its pictures say, Blocks like it, Every cable or pipe it joins, Nothing. |

### Network heart

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Networks need one | On: a network of the mod's cables shows nothing until a heart is on it. Off: it only adds channels and power. |
| Channels | How many drives, chests and crafters its network can reach in all. 0: no limit. From 0 to 100000. |
| Power each | Energy it uses each second for each thing the network reaches. Give the heart energy to hold; with too little, the network stops. From 0 to 1000000. |

Every block also has the settings on the [Block](editor-block.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Inventory, Connections, Network heart.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md), [Sound](editor-sound.md), [Particle](editor-particle.md), [Item](editor-item.md), [Code](editor-code.md).

Other things that open the same editor: [Block](thing-block.md), [Machine](thing-machine.md), [Generator](thing-generator.md), [Cable](thing-cable.md), [Pipe](thing-pipe.md), [Item pipe](thing-itemPipe.md), [Tank](thing-tank.md), [Transmitter](thing-wirelessTransmitter.md), [Receiver](thing-wirelessReceiver.md), [Wireless energy node](thing-wirelessNode.md), [Shared chest](thing-sharedChest.md), [Shared tank](thing-sharedTank.md), [Chest](thing-chest.md), [Drawer](thing-drawer.md), [Storage crate](thing-crate.md), [Mailbox](thing-mailbox.md), [Trade station](thing-tradeStation.md), [Asking chest](thing-askingChest.md), [Terminal](thing-terminal.md), [Storage cell](thing-storageCell.md), [Storage cable](thing-storageCable.md), [Drive](thing-drive.md), [Dense cable](thing-denseCable.md), [Link](thing-storeLink.md), [Access point](thing-accessPoint.md), [Crafter](thing-crafter.md), [Pattern table](thing-patternTable.md), [Matter tank](thing-matterTank.md), [Altar](thing-altar.md), [Pedestal](thing-pedestal.md), [Formed machine](thing-formedMachine.md), [Machine casing](thing-machineCasing.md), [Waypoint](thing-waypointBlock.md), [Aiming block](thing-aimingBlock.md), [Berry bush](thing-berryBush.md), [Matter pipe](thing-matterPipe.md), [Assembly station](thing-assemblyStation.md), [Carved block](thing-carvedBlock.md), [Ore](thing-ore.md), [Crop](thing-crop.md), [Plant](thing-plant.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-packFile

# Pack file

One file of a data pack or a resource pack, in any folder the game reads, yours or the game's changed.

## How to add it

- New thing > Logic and code > Pack file


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [File of your own](editor-ownFile.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | What you call it here. |
| File | Where it is: resources/common reaches every target, resources/neoforge and resources/fabric one each. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is not part of the game itself: it describes another mod or a file, so it has no side to choose.

# Painting

A picture hung on a wall.

## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Painting](editor-painting.md) editor lists every setting.

| Game name | The painting's name in the game, as a command or a data pack names it. |
| Picture | What is painted. The game draws sixteen pixels a block, so a picture two blocks by two is thirty two pixels square; more pixels a block are finer. |

| Up | How many blocks it covers on the wall, across and up. The game's own go from one by one to four by four. From 1 to 16 blocks. |
| Painted by | Whose painting it is, shown under the title. Left empty, no one is named. |
| Hung at random | Whether the game's own painting item may hang it when a player places one. Off, only a painting of it given by name hangs it. |

It is not part of the game itself: it describes another mod or a file, so it has no side to choose.

# Part

A part a tool is assembled from, cut from any material in the stonecutter, wearing its material's color.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Part


## What you can set

### Part

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Role | What it gives the tool: a head the material's uses, speed, damage and strength; a handle multiplies them; a binding adds a quarter of the material's uses. For armour: plates give the guard and the wear, trim gives toughness, a core gives knockback resistance. Choose one of: Head, Handle, Binding, Plates, Trim, Core, Body, Arm, Leg. |
| Made of | One row for each material this part is made of, such as an iron and leather plate. Leave it empty for a part of one material. Each row has: Share. |
| Gives the tool | Stat by stat, what this part gives the tool from its material, beside what its role gives. A row for a stat its role gives takes its place; a share of 0 takes it away. Each row has: Stat, How, From the material's, Share. |
| Jobs it gives a creature | On a creature built of this part, these jobs join its own work, as a carrying arm makes it pick things up and bring them home. Each row has: Does, What, With item, Where, Reach, While. |
| Its piece on a creature | The group of the creature's model drawn while this part is in it, in its material's color. Empty means the group named as the part; groups no part names are always drawn. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

# Particle

Sparks, smoke, dust and the like.

## How to add it

- New thing > Mobs and models > Particle


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Particle](editor-particle.md) editor lists every setting.

| Name | A name for you. Players see the particle, not its name. |
| Game name | The particle's name in the game, as /particle and another mod name it. |
| Picture | What one particle looks like; the game's own are eight pixels square. White takes the colour below as it is. |

| Size | How large, where 1 is the game's ordinary particle, a fifth of a block. From 0.1 to 10. |
| Colour | The colour its picture is tinted: white leaves it as drawn. |
| Gravity | How fast it falls: 0 floats, 1 falls as a dropped thing does, below 0 rises. From -2 to 2. |
| Spreads | How fast it drifts away from where it appears, each way at random, in blocks a second. From 0 to 20 blocksPerSecond. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is not part of the game itself: it describes another mod or a file, so it has no side to choose.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-pet

# Pet

A mob a player tames with an item; it sits, follows and fights for them.

## How to add it

- New thing > Mobs and models > Pet


## What you can set

### Has a spawn egg

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Egg colour | The colour of the egg itself. |
| Spot colour | The colour of the spots on the egg. |

### Can be tamed

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Tamed by | What makes it a player's: an item given to it, riding it until it calms, or only a rule's words. Choose one of: Giving it an item, Riding it until it calms, Only a rule. |
| Tamed with | The item a player gives it, one each try. |
| Chance a try | How likely each item given, or each time it is ridden, tames it. From 1 to 100 percent. |
| Sits when told | Its owner's use makes it sit and stay, and stand again. |
| Follows owner | It keeps near its owner when it is not sitting. |
| Follows from | How far its owner may go before it comes after them. From 2 to 32 blocks. |
| Catches up | Left far behind, it appears beside its owner, as a tame wolf does. |
| Strikes back at its owner | Off, a tamed one never targets or attacks its owner or the owner's team, however it was hurt, as a wolf does not. |
| Defends owner | It attacks what hurts its owner and what its owner attacks. |
| Healed with | Foods its owner gives it to heal it. |

### Habits

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Looks at | What its head turns to follow. Choose one of: What it fights, Players near, Its owner, Nothing. |
| Follows a player holding | It walks up to a player holding one of these, as a cow follows wheat. |
| Fights | When it goes after what its temperament makes it fight. Choose one of: Always, Only at night, Only by day, Only when hit. |
| Sleeps | It lies still, waking when hurt; a state named Sleeping plays while it sleeps. Choose one of: Never, At night, By day. |
| Keeps with | Whether it wanders alone, keeps near others of its kind, follows one of them as their leader, or moves as one with them in a swarm, each its spacing apart. Choose one of: Nobody, Its herd, A leader, A swarm. |
| Spacing | How far apart the swarm keeps, in blocks. Each one keeps its own place round the eldest, so the group moves as one. From 0.25 to 16 blocks. |
| Avoids | What it keeps away from, and how fast it runs from it. Each row has: What, Keeps away, Runs at. |
| Grazes on | Blocks it eats where it stands, as a sheep eats grass, healing. |
| Eats from the ground | Items lying near that it goes to and eats, healing. |
| Flees under | Hurt below this share of its health, it runs from what hurt it; none never. From 0 to 100 percent. |
| Head turns | How far its head turns from its body, either way. From 10 to 180 degrees. |
| Babies follow | A baby keeps near a grown one of its kind. |
| Heals by | How much eating heals it. From 0 to 100 halfHearts. |

Every mob also has the settings on the [Mob](editor-creature.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Has a spawn egg, Can be tamed, Habits.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-pipe

# Pipe

Carries fluid between tanks and machines.

## How to add it

- New thing > Machines and networks > Pipe


## What you can set

### Fluid

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Most it holds | Its tank. A bucket is 1,000. Set it to nothing for a pipe. From 0 to 1000000 millibuckets. |
| Most a second | The most that crosses this block each second. From 0 to 1000000 millibuckets. |
| No limit | On: fluid cross this block as fast as the blocks at both ends can give and take. The number above is ignored. |
| Only this fluid | Choose a fluid. Leave it empty and it takes whatever arrives first, then keeps to that one. |
| More tanks | Tanks beside its own, each holding a fluid of its own, as a machine taking water and giving lava. Each row has: Most it holds, Only this fluid, Reached from. |

### Connections

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Faces | Which of the six faces connect, and to what. Open the Connections tab to set them. |
| What arrives | A cable or a pipe passes it on and holds nothing. A machine, a tank or a battery keeps it. Choose one of: It keeps it, It passes it on. |
| Served before others | When several blocks want the same thing and there is not enough, the higher number is filled first. Equal numbers take turns. From -64 to 64. |
| Serves first | Whom what leaves it goes to first, for items, fluids and every stock: shared by priority, each block in turn, or the nearest along the pipes. Choose one of: By priority, Each in turn, The nearest. |
| Faces have colours | A coloured face joins only faces of its colour. Off, faces ignore colour. |
| Dyes a face steps through | How many of the sixteen dyes a channel can be set to. From 1 to 16. |
| Face modes | What pressing a face goes through, in order. Empty keeps Off, In, Out, Both. Each row has: Name, Colour, Does. |
| Players set each face | A player right-clicks a face with an empty hand and sets what it does on that placed block alone. The table is where every placed block starts. |
| Face screen | The screen a player opens by right-clicking a face of the placed block, laid out on the Face screen tab. Until it is changed there, the product draws its own rows. |
| Items a face filters | How many items a player can mark on a face, to let only those through or to keep them out. A mark is not the item: nothing is taken from the player. From 0 to 9. |
| Filter of your own | A piece of your own code that answers yes or no for each item, asked on every face beside the marks, for what the marks cannot say: damage, data, a stock level. |
| Speed upgrade | An item a player puts into a face's upgrade slot on its screen. Each one moves that face's rate again, eight at most; they drop when the block is broken. |
| Reserve room for items | An item riding through this pipe holds its place in the chest or machine it is going to, so two stacks never fight for one slot and nothing has to turn round. Turn it off and a stack just goes to the nearest place with room right now. |
| Item to link a chest | Pick an item and this block becomes a node that reaches a chest or machine without a cable. A player right-clicks the chest with the item, then right-clicks this block with it, and the network uses that chest as if it stood against the top of this block. Sneak and right-click the block to cut the link. Leave empty for a plain block. |
| How far a link reaches | The most blocks between this node and the chest it is linked to, in the same dimension. 0 means any distance. From 0 to 1024 blocks. |
| When it is broken | A block that carries more than one thing (items and fluid and energy, say) can come apart one thing at a time: mining it takes off the one added last and leaves the rest standing. Sneaking while you mine breaks the whole block. Choose one of: The whole block goes, One piece at a time. |
| Item for the items piece | What drops when the items part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Item for the fluid piece | What drops when the fluid part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Item for the energy piece | What drops when the energy part is taken off, and what a player uses on the block to put it back. Leave empty and a part taken off is gone. |
| Holds parts | Face parts go on its faces, one a face and one in the middle, and covers take another block's look. A face with no part joins only blocks of this mod, never a chest. |
| Moves by itself | Its out sides push into the blocks beside them and its in sides pull from them, with no pipe between: a machine filling the chest next to it, a block emptying a cart in front of it. Works for items, fluids, energy and your own stocks. Choose one of: No, Pushes out, Pulls in, Pushes and pulls. |
| How much a second | How much it moves each second through each side: items, or the units of a fluid, energy or stock. From 1 to 100000 perSecond. |
| Holds a cart | Stops the cart that rolls up beside it while it works, so the cart stays until the block has moved all it can, or until a rule lets it go. Needs Moves by itself. Choose one of: No, Until it has nothing more to move, Until a rule lets it go. |
| Longest it holds | The most seconds it holds one cart, so a cart is never kept for good. 0 holds as long as it takes. From 0 to 86400 seconds. |
| Destroys what none take | What no other block on its pipes takes is destroyed here, after every other block had its turn. Marks on its sides say what it destroys; with none, everything. |
| Fills a block | Whether its sides fill a block whenever it has room, or only while it holds none of what comes (one stack in each furnace, never two). Choose one of: Whenever it has room, Only when it holds none. |
| Stands in for a far block | Linked to a far chest or machine with the linking item, this block is that chest to hoppers, pipes and other mods: what goes in here goes there, and what is taken from here comes from there. |
| Joins without a seam | Where an arm of this block meets one of these, neither draws the end of its arm, so a run of them reads as one tube. A machine or a chest it meets keeps its end and its plate. Choose one of: As its pictures say, Blocks like it, Every cable or pipe it joins, Nothing. |

Every block also has the settings on the [Block](editor-block.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Fluid, Connections.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md), [Sound](editor-sound.md), [Particle](editor-particle.md), [Item](editor-item.md), [Code](editor-code.md).

Other things that open the same editor: [Block](thing-block.md), [Machine](thing-machine.md), [Generator](thing-generator.md), [Cable](thing-cable.md), [Item pipe](thing-itemPipe.md), [Tank](thing-tank.md), [Transmitter](thing-wirelessTransmitter.md), [Receiver](thing-wirelessReceiver.md), [Wireless energy node](thing-wirelessNode.md), [Shared chest](thing-sharedChest.md), [Shared tank](thing-sharedTank.md), [Chest](thing-chest.md), [Drawer](thing-drawer.md), [Storage crate](thing-crate.md), [Mailbox](thing-mailbox.md), [Trade station](thing-tradeStation.md), [Asking chest](thing-askingChest.md), [Terminal](thing-terminal.md), [Storage cell](thing-storageCell.md), [Storage cable](thing-storageCable.md), [Drive](thing-drive.md), [Network heart](thing-networkHeart.md), [Dense cable](thing-denseCable.md), [Link](thing-storeLink.md), [Access point](thing-accessPoint.md), [Crafter](thing-crafter.md), [Pattern table](thing-patternTable.md), [Matter tank](thing-matterTank.md), [Altar](thing-altar.md), [Pedestal](thing-pedestal.md), [Formed machine](thing-formedMachine.md), [Machine casing](thing-machineCasing.md), [Waypoint](thing-waypointBlock.md), [Aiming block](thing-aimingBlock.md), [Berry bush](thing-berryBush.md), [Matter pipe](thing-matterPipe.md), [Assembly station](thing-assemblyStation.md), [Carved block](thing-carvedBlock.md), [Ore](thing-ore.md), [Crop](thing-crop.md), [Plant](thing-plant.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-plant

# Plant

A flower or small plant that stands on grass, as a poppy.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Plant


## What you can set

### Grows as a plant

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Stages | How many times it grows before it is ripe: wheat grows 7 times, beetroot 3. 0 is a flower that never grows. Each stage wears its own picture; ripe, it wears the block's own. From 0 to 7. |
| Picture just planted | What it wears at this stage; with none it wears the block's own picture. |
| Picture at stage 1 | What it wears at this stage; with none it wears the block's own picture. |
| Picture at stage 2 | What it wears at this stage; with none it wears the block's own picture. |
| Picture at stage 3 | What it wears at this stage; with none it wears the block's own picture. |
| Picture at stage 4 | What it wears at this stage; with none it wears the block's own picture. |
| Picture at stage 5 | What it wears at this stage; with none it wears the block's own picture. |
| Picture at stage 6 | What it wears at this stage; with none it wears the block's own picture. |
| Gives when ripe | What breaking it ripe gives, the game's or your own, as wheat gives wheat; its seeds come too. Broken before, it gives back one seed. |
| Up to | At most this many of it, at least one. From 1 to 16. |
| Stands on | What it can be planted on and stays on: farmland as wheat, grass and dirt as a flower, sand as a cactus, or the top of anything solid. Take that away and it breaks. Choose one of: Farmland, Grass and dirt, Sand, Anything solid. |
| Drawn as | A crop is four upright pictures in a square, as wheat; a cross is two pictures crossing, as a flower or a sapling. Choose one of: A crop, A cross. |
| Name of its seeds | What the seeds that plant it are called in the game, as Wheat Seeds; with none, its own name and Seeds. |
| Picture of its seeds | The seeds in the hand and the inventory; with none, its first picture. |
| Bone meal grows it | Bone meal on it makes it grow a stage or more at once, as on wheat. |

Every block also has the settings on the [Block](editor-block.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Grows as a plant.

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-playerAnimation

# Player animation

How a player's body moves for a moment, a wave or a bow, played on a player by a rule.

## How to add it

- New thing > Mobs and models > Player animation


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Animation](editor-animation.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | A name for you, shown in the project and on a mob's Animations tab. Players never see it. |
| Model | The model whose parts this animation moves. It has to be one made for a mob, because the animation is kept by that model's parts. |
| Keys | How each part turns, moves and grows over time. Edited on the Animate tab. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is written into the mod when you [Cook](glossary.md#cook) or press [Play](glossary.md#play).

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md).

Other things that open the same editor: [Animation](thing-animation.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-pocket

# Pocket

Put into a backpack in the crafting grid, it adds nine slots.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Pocket


## What you can set

### Module

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Goes into | What it can be installed into. Choose one of: Anything that takes modules, A tool, A weapon, Armor, Something that holds items. |
| Gains levels by | How it goes up a level: put in again (each time one more level), or by what the one wearing or holding it does. Choose one of: Putting it in again, What the player does. |
| Counts | What the player does that counts toward its next level while the thing it goes into is worn or held. Choose one of: Blocks run, Blocks walked, Blocks swum, Blocks flown, Blocks fallen, Jumps, Damage taken, Damage dealt, Mobs killed, Blocks mined, Seconds worn. |
| For each level | How much of what it counts makes one more level: 100 blocks run is level 1, 200 is level 2, up to its most levels and the room the thing has for it. From 1 to 100000000. |
| Energy each use | What it spends of the item's energy each block mined or hit, or each second while worn; nought and it costs nothing. From 0 to 1000000000. |
| Changes the tool | What it changes of the item it is installed in while switched on, each level once more: any stat, the game's or a material's own. Each row has: Stat, How, Amount, Only on blocks. |
| Most levels | Installed again it goes up a level, to this many. From 1 to 100. |
| Slots a level | How many of the host's slots each level takes. From 0 to 54. |
| Put in by hand | Used while the thing it goes into is in the other hand, it goes in (a gem into a socket). That thing used crouching with the other hand empty gives the last one back. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Module.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-pointer

# Pointer

An item whose needle turns toward something: a transmitter on a channel, a mob you tagged, or the nearest block of a kind. It shows a map when used crouching.

## How to add it

- New thing > Blocks and items > Pointer


## What you can set

### Points the way

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Points to | The blocks, mobs and players on a channel; the one mob or player you use it on; or the nearest block of a kind. Choose one of: Everything on a channel, The mob or player it was used on, The nearest block of a kind. |
| Channel | The channel's name: blocks linked on it, and mobs and players a rule put on it. |
| Blocks | The blocks it looks for, or a tag of them; it turns to the nearest one within its range (Looks as far as). |
| Looks as far as | How far it looks, in blocks. For the nearest block of a kind, up to 256 and only through loaded ground; 0 looks 16 blocks. From 0 to 100000 blocks. |
| Looks again every | How often the search for the nearest block of a kind runs again. A wide range reads many blocks, so search it less often; at least every half second. From 0.5 to 600 seconds. |
| Says while held | What it says over the hotbar while you hold it. Choose one of: The name and how far, How far, Nothing. |
| Look | The game's compass with a turning needle, or your own picture that does not turn. Choose one of: A turning needle, Its own picture. |
| Map when used crouching | Used while crouching, it shows a map of the marks around you, with how far and which way. |

Every item also has the settings on the [Item](editor-item.md) page.

## What it becomes in the game

It is added to the game, so a player needs your mod to see it.

It comes with these abilities already on: Points the way.

## What it works with

It points at: [Model](editor-model.md).

# https://modryos.com/docs/thing-potion

# Potion

A drink that gives an effect.

## How to add it

- New thing > Crafting and loot > Potion


## What you can set

The main settings are below. The [Potion](editor-potion.md) editor lists every setting.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | The bottle's name. Its splash, lingering and arrow forms are named from it. |
| Game name | The potion's name in the game, as /give and a data pack name it. |
| Effects | What drinking it gives, each for its time and at its level. Each row has: Effect, For, Level, Swirls. |
| Brewed with | What goes in the top of the brewing stand to make it. |
| From | The potion it is brewed from, most often the Awkward Potion a Nether wart makes. |

## What it becomes in the game

It is not part of the game itself: it describes another mod or a file, so it has no side to choose.

## What it works with

It points at: [Effect](editor-effect.md).
